## How much does interlock cleaning and resealing cost?
Most Ontario homeowners want one number: what will it cost to bring my interlock back and protect it? Our wash, sand and seal package is a flat $3.50 per square foot (plus 13% HST). That covers the hot-water surface-cleaner wash, fresh polymeric sand in the joints and a protective sealer applied once the pavers are dry.
Here is what that looks like on typical GTA properties:
Sample interlock wash, sand and seal prices at $3.50 per square foot
Typical areaSizePrice before HSTTotal with 13% HST
Front walkway and steps150 sq ft$525$593.25
Single-car driveway (12 × 20 ft)240 sq ft$840$949.20
Backyard patio (14 × 16 ft)224 sq ft$784$885.92
Double driveway (20 × 20 ft)400 sq ft$1,400$1,582
Driveway plus front walkway600 sq ft$2,100$2,373
Large driveway, walkway and patio1,000 sq ft$3,500$3,955
Prices are before any extras that a specific surface may need (see below). For a fixed written quote, request a free assessment.
## How to measure your interlock in 4 steps
- Measure each area. Use a tape measure for the length and width in feet and multiply to get square feet.
- Split irregular shapes. Break L-shaped or curved areas into rectangles and add them up.
- Add the totals. Driveway, walkway, patio, steps and pool deck all count. Working in metres? Multiply square metres by 10.76.
- Multiply by $3.50. Add 13% HST, or just type the measurements into the calculator above.
## What is included in the price
- Hot-water rotary surface-cleaner wash — no stripes or paver damage
- Removal of moss, algae, dirt and weeds from the surface and joints
- Fresh polymeric sand in the joints, so pavers lock and weeds stay out
- Protective sealer applied to clean, dry interlock
- Our own equipment, water supply and clean-up
- Free assessment and a fixed written quote
- Certificate of insurance and WSIB clearance on request
- Re-clean guarantee
## What can change the price
- Surface condition. Heavy oil, rust or efflorescence needs extra treatment.
- Old or failing sealer. It has to be stripped before new sealer will bond.
- Access. Steep grades, no water access or long hose runs add time.
- Joint condition. Deep weed growth or badly settled pavers may need repair first.
We always tell you about any of these before work starts — never on the invoice. Read more in our pressure washing cost factors guide.
## The wash, sand and seal process
We wash first because sealer over dirt traps it. After the interlock is clean and fully dry, polymeric sand is swept into the joints and activated, and the sealer goes on last. Rushing the order — or sealing damp pavers — is what causes white haze and peeling, so we schedule around the weather. See our full interlock cleaning and re-sanding guide.

## How often should interlock be resealed?
Most sealed interlock needs re-sealing every two to four years. Sun-baked driveways and high-traffic areas wear sooner; sheltered walkways last longer. If water no longer beads on the surface or joint sand keeps washing out, it is time for a check. We will tell you honestly whether it needs sealing again.
## Why homeowners choose Living Water
Living Water has washed more than 7,500 properties across the GTA since 1998, carries $5M liability insurance and WSIB coverage, and holds a 4.9 / 5 rating on Google. ## Interlock Cleaning & Sealing Cost FAQ
Anything not covered here? Call (416) 663-8000 and ask.
How much does interlock cleaning and sealing cost in Toronto?
Living Water's full interlock wash, polymeric sand and seal package is $3.50 per square foot plus HST across Toronto and the GTA. A 400 sq ft double driveway is $1,400 before HST, and a 150 sq ft front walkway is $525 before HST.
How do I calculate the square footage of my interlock driveway or patio?
Multiply the length by the width in feet for each rectangular area, then add the areas together. Split L-shaped or curved areas into rectangles and estimate. If you measure in metres, multiply square metres by 10.76 to get square feet — the calculator above does this when you switch to metres.
What is included in the $3.50 per square foot price?
A hot-water surface-cleaner wash that removes dirt, moss and algae, flushing out the old joint sand, re-sanding with polymeric sand, and application of a protective sealer once the interlock is fully dry. We also bring and remove our own equipment and clean up.
Is HST included in the estimate?
No. The $3.50 per square foot price is before HST. The calculator shows the 13% HST separately so you can see the total you would pay.
Is the online estimate my final price?
It is a close guide for a standard job, and we confirm a fixed written price after a free assessment, before any work starts. Heavy staining, efflorescence, old failing sealer that must be stripped, or very difficult access can change the price — we tell you first.
How much does it cost to clean interlock without sealing?
We price wash-only jobs from your measurements and the condition of the surface, so ask for a fixed written quote. The $3.50 per square foot rate is for the complete wash, sand and seal package.
How often does interlock need to be resealed?
Most sealed interlock is re-sealed every two to four years, depending on the sealer used, sun exposure and traffic. We check the surface at your assessment and tell you honestly whether it needs sealing again.
When can interlock be washed and sealed in Ontario?
Sealer needs clean, completely dry pavers and mild, dry weather, so the main season runs from spring thaw through fall. Residential jobs are typically booked within two to five days of your quote.
Do I need to be home during the work?
Not usually. We need access to the area and an outdoor tap if available, and we keep you updated. We will tell you how long to keep cars and foot traffic off the sealed surface for the sealer being used.
Which areas do you serve?
Toronto, Vaughan, Markham, Richmond Hill, Mississauga, Oakville, Burlington, Brampton, Etobicoke, North York, Scarborough, Pickering, Whitby, Oshawa, Newmarket, Aurora, Hamilton, Barrie and the wider GTA.

Living Water washes, re-sands and seals interlock for $3.50 per square foot plus HST across Toronto and the GTA. The price covers a hot-water surface-cleaner wash, fresh polymeric sand in the joints and a protective sealer — for example, $1,400 before HST for a 400 sq ft double driveway.

Wash + polymeric sand + seal · plus HST · fixed written quoteCalculate my price
## What you get for $3.50 per square foot
One price, three steps, one crew. Instead of piecing together a cleaner, a sand supplier and a sealing contractor, Living Water handles the whole interlock restoration:
### 1Wash
A hot-water rotary surface cleaner lifts dirt, moss, algae and weeds from the pavers and flushes out the tired joint sand. No stripes, no paver damage.
### 2Sand
Once the surface is clean and dry, polymeric sand is swept into the joints and activated so the pavers lock together and weeds and ants stay out.
### 3Seal
A protective sealer enriches colour and makes stains easier to clean. It goes on only after the interlock is clean, dry and free of efflorescence.

## Why get it all done at once
Washing, re-sanding and sealing are a sequence: clean pavers take sand better, and sand-locked joints take sealer better. Doing all three together means the interlock stays tight, the colour is richer and the surface is easier to keep clean. The result typically lasts two to four years before it needs re-sealing, depending on the sealer, sun and traffic.

Questions
## Wash, Sand & Seal FAQ
Anything not covered here? Call (416) 663-8000 and ask.
What does wash, sand and seal mean?
Wash is a hot-water surface-cleaner clean that removes dirt, moss, algae and weeds. Sand is re-filling the joints with polymeric sand so the pavers lock together and weeds stay out. Seal is a protective sealer applied once the interlock is clean and dry.
Is it really $3.50 per square foot?
Yes. Living Water charges $3.50 per square foot plus HST for the complete wash, sand and seal package on standard residential interlock. We confirm the exact figure in a fixed written quote after a free assessment.
What would my driveway cost?
Multiply the square footage by $3.50. A 240 sq ft single-car driveway is $840 before HST; a 400 sq ft double driveway is $1,400 before HST. Use the estimator on this page for your exact measurements.
Does the price include HST?
No — HST (13%) is added to the $3.50 per square foot price. The estimator shows both figures.
Can I just have my interlock washed and not sealed?
Yes. Sealing is optional, and we price wash-only or wash and re-sand jobs from your measurements. Ask for a fixed written quote.
Why does interlock need re-sanding after washing?
Cleaning flushes the old, weedy joint sand out along with the dirt. Fresh polymeric sand locks the pavers in place and resists weeds, ants and washout.
Is sealing worth it?
A sealer enriches colour and makes stains easier to clean, and it helps joint sand stay put. It must go on clean, dry pavers with no efflorescence, and it needs re-applying every few years. We will tell you honestly if your surface does not need it.
Do you offer free quotes?
Yes. Estimates and assessments are free, and every price is a fixed written quote before any work starts. We also send a certificate of insurance and WSIB clearance on request.

Living Water provides post-construction masonry cleaning for home builders across Ontario: removing mortar smears, construction dust, rust marks and white efflorescence from new brick, stone and precast on single homes, townhome blocks and condo towers, scheduled around your trades and ready for final inspection and closing. We carry $5M liability insurance and WSIB clearance, and quote each project at a fixed price.
Reviewed by the Living Water team · November 2026 · 28 years of field experience
## Masonry cleaning built for home builders
The last thing between a finished build and a happy buyer is a clean exterior. Mortar smears, dust from cutting, rust runs, grout haze and white efflorescence are all normal on new masonry, but they show up at the pre-delivery inspection and in the buyer's first photos. Living Water cleans them off so your brick, stone and precast look the way they were specified.
### Single homes and custom builds
Stone cladding, brick and limestone-look facades, porches, steps and driveways cleaned and ready for handover.
### Townhome blocks and subdivisions
Block-by-block programs priced per unit or per block, so you can plan costs across a phase.
### Condo towers and podiums
Dark brick, limestone bases and precast cleaned from boom lifts and lift baskets after construction.
### Models, sales centres and show homes
A quick, careful clean so the property looks its best for buyers and photography.
## What we remove from new masonry
- Mortar smears and splatter
- Construction dust and dirt
- White efflorescence on brick, stone and precast
- Rust and metal run-off stains
- Grout haze and cement residue
- Efflorescence on pavers, steps and copings
- Algae and organic growth on exposed walls
- General soiling before final photos

## Why builders choose Living Water
- 28 years on the job. We have cleaned 7,500+ properties across the GTA, including new condo and townhome developments.
- Safe on new masonry. Methods are matched to the brick, stone or precast, and tested first, so mortar and finishes are protected.
- Equipment for height. Boom lifts, lift baskets and pole systems for tall elevations.
- Site-ready paperwork. $5M liability insurance and WSIB clearance on request, and we follow your site safety rules.
- Fits your schedule. Early, late and weekend work around other trades.
- Warranty know-how. We remove efflorescence as a service provider for several Ontario stone manufacturers.
- Photo reports. Before-and-after photos for your files and your customers.
## How a builder project works
- Send the details. Address, number of units or elevations, masonry type and photos or drawings.
- Quote. A fixed written price per unit, block or phase.
- Schedule. We coordinate with your site super around trades, inspections and closings.
- Clean. Test area first, then the full clean, with protection for windows, landscaping and finishes.
- Report. Before-and-after photos and notes on anything we see, such as ongoing efflorescence or sealed joints.
## Efflorescence on new builds
Efflorescence is the white, powdery salt deposit left when moisture moves through masonry and evaporates. It is cosmetic, common on new brick, stone and pavers, and can reappear until the masonry dries out. Read our guide on how to remove efflorescence or see our efflorescence removal service. For brick, see brick cleaning and stone restoration.

Questions
## Builder Masonry Cleaning FAQ
Anything not covered here? Call (416) 663-8000 and ask.
What is post-construction masonry cleaning?
It is the final clean of new brick, stone, precast and concrete after the masons and other trades finish. It removes mortar smears and splatter, construction dust, stains, rust marks and efflorescence so the building looks right at inspection and closing.
Why does new brick and stone get white efflorescence?
New masonry holds moisture from mortar and construction. As it dries, water carries natural salts to the surface and leaves a white powdery bloom. It is common on new buildings, and we remove it so the colour shows true before handover.
When should masonry be cleaned on a new build?
Usually after the masonry is complete and cured and before final landscaping, final inspection and occupancy or closing. Cleaning too early lets later trades re-soil the walls, and we can coordinate timing with your site super.
Do you clean townhome blocks and condo towers?
Yes. We clean multi-unit townhome blocks, condo podiums, limestone bases and tall brick elevations using boom lifts, ladders and pole systems, working floor by floor or block by block.
How do you price masonry cleaning for builders?
Per project, from the wall area, height and access, the masonry type and how soiled it is. We give a fixed written quote after reviewing drawings or photos or a site visit, and can price per unit, per block or as a program across subdivisions.
Can you clean without damaging new brick, stone or mortar?
Yes. We match the cleaner and pressure to the masonry, test a small area first, and avoid aggressive methods that can etch limestone or open mortar joints.
Do you provide insurance and WSIB documents for site access?
Yes. We provide a Certificate of Insurance ($5M liability) and WSIB clearance, and follow your site safety rules and sign-in procedures.
Can you work around other trades and tight schedules?
Yes. We schedule early mornings, evenings and weekends, coordinate with the site super, and move quickly to keep final cleans off your critical path.
Which parts of Ontario do you serve?
Toronto and the GTA, plus Hamilton, Niagara, Barrie and surrounding communities. Contact us for projects further afield.
Can you remove efflorescence on stone covered by a manufacturer warranty?
Yes. Living Water is relied on by several Ontario stone and paver manufacturers as a warranty service provider for efflorescence removal. Ask us to coordinate with your supplier.

# Pressure Washing Prices in Toronto & the GTA
Published starting prices, what affects cost, and free fixed written quotes.

- 7,500+properties cleaned

Pressure washing in Toronto and the GTA is priced by surface, area, access and how soiled the job is. Living Water publishes starting prices where they are fixed: interlock wash, sand and seal at $3.50 per square foot, and elevator pit cleaning from $1,500 per single pit. Everything else gets a free, fixed written quote before work starts.

These vary too much by site to publish one number, so we quote each after a photo review or visit:
- Residential power washing

## What affects the price
- Surface type and condition
- Total area and how many levels or elevations
- Access, height and equipment such as boom lifts
- Staining, paint, graffiti or efflorescence
- Add-ons such as sealing or sanding
- Timing, after-hours work and travel distance
Our guide to pressure washing cost factors explains these in more detail.

Questions
## Pressure Washing Prices FAQ
Anything not covered here? Call (416) 663-8000 and ask.
How much does pressure washing cost in Toronto?
It depends on the surface, area, access and how soiled it is. Living Water gives a free fixed written quote before work starts. Published starting prices: interlock wash, sand and seal at $3.50 per sq ft (before HST), and elevator pit cleaning from $1,500 per single pit.
Do you charge per square foot?
For interlock wash, sand and seal we price at $3.50 per square foot before HST. Most other work is quoted per job because access, height, surface and soiling vary.
Are your prices before or after HST?
Prices shown are before 13% HST unless stated, and HST is added to the final invoice.
Why do quotes for the same size of driveway differ between companies?
Scope differs: some quotes cover only a surface rinse, while others include degreasing, edge detail, polymeric sand and sealing. Ask what is included, what insurance the contractor carries and whether the price is fixed.
Do you offer free quotes?
Yes. Assessments are free and you get a fixed written price, with our Certificate of Insurance and WSIB clearance, before any work starts.
What makes a job cost more?
Height or hard access, heavy staining or paint, delicate surfaces that need slower methods, after-hours work, travel distance and added services such as sealing.
Can I get an instant estimate?
For interlock wash, sand and seal, yes: use our online estimator. For other services, send photos and your address for a quick quote.

Questions
## FAQ
Anything not covered here? Call (416) 663-8000 and ask.
What services do you provide to condo corporations and property managers?
Garage and podium washing, entrance and walkway cleaning, facade and brick washing, graffiti removal, elevator pit cleaning and emergency water cleanup, scheduled to suit your building and your residents.
Do you provide insurance and WSIB documents?
Yes. We provide a $5M liability Certificate of Insurance and WSIB clearance for your files before work starts, and follow your contractor sign-in and safety rules.
Can work be done after hours or on weekends?
Yes. We schedule around residents and building operations, including evenings and weekends where the property allows.
Can you set up a regular maintenance schedule?
Yes. Many buildings book a spring wash after the salt season and a fall clean before winter, with extra visits for entrances and high-traffic areas. We can quote a recurring program.
How much does elevator pit cleaning cost?
Published starting prices are $1,500 for a single pit (up to 4 inches of water), $2,500 for a double, $3,500 for a triple and $4,500 for four pits, each including full cleaning and sanitizing ready for paint, before HST.
Do you handle emergency water or flooding in garages and pits?
Yes. Our 24/7 emergency line is (647) 833-4343 for water removal and cleanup in garages, mechanical areas and elevator pits.
How do you quote for a board or property manager?
A free assessment or photo review, then a fixed written price you can take to the board for approval.

## Straight answers from 28 years on the tools
Guide
### Soft Washing vs Pressure Washing: Which Does Your Property Need?
Soft washing uses low pressure (similar to a garden hose) plus biodegradable cleaners to kill and dissolve algae, mould and mildew; pressure washing uses high-pressure…Read guide →Guide
### How to Remove Efflorescence from Brick, Stone & Interlock
Efflorescence is a white, powdery salt deposit left when water moves through brick, concrete, stone or mortar and evaporates at the surface. Light, fresh efflorescence…Read guide →Guide
### Is Sandblasting Safe for Brick? Media Blasting Options Explained
Traditional sandblasting with coarse abrasive at high pressure is not safe for most brick — it strips the hard outer face, exposes the soft core to water and freeze-thaw…Read guide →

## Frequently Asked Questions
Anything not covered here? Call (416) 663-8000 and ask.
How quickly can Living Water start?
Residential jobs are usually booked within 2–5 days, and same-week service is standard. Commercial and industrial clients get 24/7 emergency response on (647) 833-4343.
Are you licensed and insured?
Yes. Living Water is fully licensed in Ontario, carries $5 million in commercial general liability insurance, is WSIB covered and ISSA-GBAC certified. We send a Certificate of Insurance to your property manager, condo board or HOA on request.
Will pressure washing damage my driveway, brick or siding?
Not when it is done right. We match the pressure, nozzle, water temperature and chemistry to each surface — interlock, brick, vinyl, stucco, stone and wood all need different approaches. Where high pressure is wrong we soft wash, steam or use media blasting instead.
Do you do commercial and industrial work?
Yes — refineries, plants, silos and tanks, heritage restoration, graffiti removal, sandblasting and elevator pit cleaning. Many of our clients are property managers, general contractors and municipalities. Our crews are certified boom and scissor lift operators.
What areas do you serve?
Toronto and the entire Greater Toronto Area, including Mississauga, Brampton, Vaughan, Markham, Richmond Hill, Oakville, Burlington, Pickering, Ajax, Whitby and Oshawa, plus Hamilton, Niagara, Guelph, Cambridge, Barrie and Simcoe County.
Is the quote free?
Yes. Assessments are free and no-obligation, and you receive a fixed written quote before any work starts.

Professional Power
## Why professional power washing?
Professional power washing removes dirt, algae, grease and stains while protecting the surface underneath — because the right equipment, pressure, water temperature and cleaning chemistry differ for every material.
- Restores curb appeal and a fresh, clean appearance
- Removes dirt, grime, algae, grease, stains and stubborn build-up
- Helps protect exterior surfaces from premature wear
- Improves safety by removing slippery contaminants
- Uses professional equipment and surface-specific techniques
- Saves time with efficient, consistent, reliable results

A quick guide to matching the problem to the right method.
ProblemBest serviceTypical method
Dirty driveway, interlock, siding or roofResidential power washingSoft wash or hot-water pressure wash
Gum, grease and grime at a plaza or garageCommercial power washingHot-water pressure wash, degreaser
Tanks, silos, plant equipment, condenser pipesIndustrial power washingHigh pressure, hydro jetting
Rust, epoxy or failing paint on metal, concrete or poolsSandblastingDustless, soda, micro or dry ice blasting
Painted or stained brickBrick cleaning & paint removalChemical stripping, low-pressure rinse
White powder on brick, stone or paversEfflorescence removalMaterial-specific cleaner, controlled rinse
Tags and spray paintGraffiti removalBio-friendly remover, anti-graffiti coat
Water, oil or debris in an elevator pitElevator pit cleaningPump-out, degrease, sanitize
Historic building or monumentHistorical remediationSteam, soda or micro blasting, poultices
Fire, flood, wind or mould damageDisaster restoration24/7 securing, extraction, remediation

# Residential Power Washing in Toronto & the GTA
Your home's exterior, gently restored. Driveways, interlock, siding, decks and walkways washed back to the colour you bought.
Get a Free QuoteCall (416) 663-8000
- Since 199828 years in business
- 7,500+properties cleaned
- $5Mliability insured
- WSIBcovered & ISSA-GBAC
- 4.9 / 5rated on Google
Living Water cleans the outside of homes across Toronto and the GTA — driveways, interlock, patios, brick, stone, stucco, siding, roofs, decks and fences — using low-pressure soft washing with biodegradable cleaners where high pressure would damage siding, mortar or window seals.
Reviewed by the Living Water team · November 2026 · 28 years of field experience
## At a glance
Best forDriveways, interlock, patios, siding, roofs, decks, brick and stone
MethodsSoft washing, hot-water pressure washing, surface cleaners, sealing
Who we serveHomeowners, HOAs
AvailabilityUsually booked within 2–5 days
CoverageToronto & the GTA, Hamilton, Niagara, Barrie
QuoteFree assessment, fixed written price
- 
- 
- 
Ontario weather is hard on a house. Road salt, spring pollen, summer algae and autumn leaves leave driveways stained, interlock green and brick dull. Residential power washing removes that build-up safely, restoring curb appeal and protecting the materials you paid for.
High pressure is not always the answer. It can strip sand from interlock joints, etch soft stone, blow out mortar and force water behind siding. Our technicians choose between soft washing, hot-water pressure washing and gentle media cleaning for each surface — the judgement that comes from washing 7,500+ properties since 1998.
## What we clean at your home
- Driveways, interlock and pavers
- Patios, pool decks and coping
- Exterior and interior brick
- Stone, cement, limestone and precast
- Stucco cleaning and soft wash treatments
- Roofs: cedar, ceramic and metal
- Gutters, siding and windows
- Decks and fences
- Efflorescence on walls, steps and stone
- Sealant removal from pavers
- Professional paint removal
- Sandblasting for concrete and pools
## Soft washing vs. pressure washing
Soft washing uses low pressure and biodegradable cleaners to dissolve algae, mildew and grime on siding, stucco and roofs. Pressure washing — often with hot water — lifts oil, tire marks and deep dirt from concrete and interlock. Most homes need both, and we tell you which surface gets which.
## Sealing after cleaning
Once interlock, natural stone or pool coping is clean and dry, sealing can help it resist stains and fading. We will tell you honestly whether your surface benefits from a sealer.

Questions
## Residential Power Washing FAQ
Anything not covered here? Call (416) 663-8000 and ask.
How often should I pressure wash my driveway?
Most GTA homeowners wash driveways and interlock every one to two years, ideally in spring to remove winter salt and again if moss or oil stains appear.
Can you clean my roof without damaging shingles?
Yes. Roofs are soft washed at low pressure with cleaners that kill moss and algae, so granules and shingles are not damaged. We clean cedar, ceramic and metal roofs.
Do I need to be home during the cleaning?
Not usually. We need access to an outdoor water tap and the areas being cleaned. We send before and after photos when the job is complete.
Do you move patio furniture?
Yes. Our crews move and replace patio furniture and protect plants, windows and nearby surfaces as part of the job.
How much does residential pressure washing cost in Toronto?
Price depends on the surfaces, their size and their condition. Every job is a fixed written quote after a free assessment, so you know the price before work starts. As a reference, our interlock wash, sand and seal package is $3.50 per square foot plus HST.
Is pressure washing safe for my lawn and plants?
Yes. We use biodegradable cleaners, pre-wet and rinse nearby plants, and protect landscaping and windows before we start.
What is the best time of year to pressure wash a house in Ontario?
From spring thaw through fall, when temperatures stay above freezing and surfaces dry properly. Spring is popular for removing winter salt, and fall for cleaning before sealing and freeze-thaw.
Which parts of the GTA do you serve for home washing?
Toronto, North York, Scarborough, Etobicoke, Mississauga, Brampton, Vaughan, Markham, Richmond Hill, Oakville, Burlington, Hamilton, Pickering, Whitby, Oshawa, Newmarket, Aurora and Barrie.

Reviewed by the Living Water team · November 2026 · 28 years of field experience

Best forPlazas, storefronts, sidewalks, parking lots and garages, schools, restaurants

A clean property builds trust before a customer walks in. Living Water serves small businesses and large commercial organizations across Ontario, and many of our clients are property managers, condominium boards and facility managers who need dependable, insured contractors.
We specialise in removing stains, gum, graffiti and hazardous grease build-up, and in restoring brick and concrete. Work can be scheduled overnight or on weekends to avoid disrupting tenants and customers.
## Benefits of commercial power washing
- Improved appearance — clean facades, walkways and entrances help attract customers and protect your reputation.
- Enhanced safety — removing grime, algae and grease helps prevent slips and falls.
- Longer surface life — regular cleaning slows deterioration and avoids costly repairs and replacement.

### Schools
Exterior surfaces, entrances and playgrounds cleaned safely.
### Restaurants
Patios, sidewalks, dumpster pads and grease-stained areas.
### Plazas & shared buildings
Sidewalks, walls, storefronts and common areas.

Questions
## Commercial Pressure Washing FAQ
Anything not covered here? Call (416) 663-8000 and ask.
Can you work after hours?
Yes. We regularly schedule commercial work overnight and on weekends so tenants, shoppers and staff are not disrupted.
Do you provide a Certificate of Insurance?
Yes. We carry $5 million commercial general liability and full WSIB coverage, and send a COI and WSIB clearance with every quote.
Can you set up a maintenance schedule?
Yes. Many property managers book seasonal or monthly cleaning for entrances, garages and walkways.
How is commercial pressure washing priced?
By the area, the surface, how dirty it is, access, and how often we visit. Recurring programs are priced lower per visit than one-off cleans. Every job is a fixed written quote after a free assessment, so you know the price before work starts.
Can you remove gum, grease and stains from storefront sidewalks?
Yes. Hot-water pressure washing and surface cleaners lift gum, grease and ground-in stains from sidewalks, entrances and plazas, and we work early morning or after hours so customers are not disrupted.
Can you wash tall building facades?
Yes. We use boom lifts, ladders and pole systems to wash brick, stone and precast facades and signs safely, with the area coned off and protected.
Do you clean schools, hospitals and offices?
Yes. We have washed school buildings, hospital entrances, office campuses and condo podiums, and we work around operating hours and safety rules on site.

Questions
## Industrial Pressure Washing FAQ
Anything not covered here? Call (416) 663-8000 and ask.
What is hydro jetting?
Hydro jetting uses very high-pressure water streams to scour build-up from the inside of pipes, condensers and lines without abrasive media.
Do you offer emergency industrial cleaning?
Yes. Industrial and commercial clients can reach our 24/7 emergency line at (647) 833-4343.
Can you clean food processing plants?
Yes. We provide pressure washing, sanitation and disinfection for food plants, scheduled around production.
Do you clean storage tanks and silos?
Yes. We wash tank and silo exteriors and roofs from boom lifts and, where needed, interiors, with a written site safety plan.
Can you work during plant shutdowns or overnight?
Yes. We schedule around shutdowns and run overnight shifts so production is not interrupted.
Can you degrease heavy equipment such as cranes and machinery?
Yes. Hot water and industrial degreasers remove oil, mud and build-up from tracks, undercarriages and engine bays on cranes and other heavy equipment.
How is industrial cleaning priced?
By scope, access, hazards and time on site. Every job is a fixed written quote after a free assessment, so you know the price before work starts.

# Sandblasting & Dustless Media Blasting in Toronto
The efficient way to strip rust, scale, stains and old coatings and prepare surfaces for painting.
Get a Free QuoteCall (416) 663-8000
- Since 199828 years in business
- 7,500+properties cleaned
- $5Mliability insured
- WSIBcovered & ISSA-GBAC
- 4.9 / 5rated on Google
Living Water offers mobile dustless sandblasting, wet and dry abrasive blasting, micro blasting, soda blasting and dry ice blasting across Toronto and the GTA to remove rust, scale, paint and epoxy from steel, aluminium, brick, concrete and pools.
Reviewed by the Living Water team · November 2026 · 28 years of field experience
## At a glance
Best forSteel, aluminium, concrete, pools, durable masonry, coatings
MethodsDustless wet blasting, dry blasting, micro, soda and dry ice blasting
Who we serveContractors, pool companies, restoration firms, owners
AvailabilityMobile service across the GTA
CoverageToronto & the GTA, Hamilton, Niagara, Barrie
QuoteFree assessment, fixed written price
Sandblasting — also called abrasive blasting — drives a high-pressure stream of media against a surface to remove rust, scale, stains and old paint. It is the fastest way to prepare metal, masonry and concrete for painting, coating or other treatments.
We work for general contractors, pool painting companies, fire restoration firms, renovation and maintenance companies, and residential, commercial and industrial property owners. Our team can explain why a particular blasting method will — or will not — suit your project.
## Why choose dustless blasting
- Efficient and effective — removes rust, scale, stains and old coatings quickly, leaving a clean profile ready for treatment.
- Versatile — steel and aluminium, brick facades, concrete pool shells, machinery, bridges, tanks, and water and sewage plants.
- Environmentally responsible — dustless technology keeps airborne dust down and uses environmentally friendly media.
## Blasting services
### Abrasive blasting
Removes rust, scale, stains and old paint from a wide range of surfaces.
### Aluminium & steel blasting
Media and pressure matched to metal so the substrate is not damaged.
### Wet & dry sandblasting
Chosen per surface — wet blasting controls dust on sensitive sites.
### Dry ice blasting
Lifts coatings and residue without abrasive media or secondary waste.
### Pool repainting prep
Concrete pool shells blasted clean and ready to repaint.
### Epoxy coating removal
Old epoxy floors and coatings stripped back to sound concrete.

Questions
## Sandblasting & Media Blasting FAQ
Anything not covered here? Call (416) 663-8000 and ask.
Is sandblasting safe for brick?
It can be, with the right media and pressure. Soft or heritage brick often needs micro blasting or soda blasting instead of sand. We assess first and test a small area.
What is dustless sandblasting?
Dustless blasting mixes water with the abrasive media so dust is captured at the surface, making it cleaner and safer for occupied or urban sites.
Do you blast swimming pools?
Yes. We blast concrete pool shells to remove failing paint so they can be repainted.
What is the difference between sandblasting and media blasting?
Sandblasting is a general name for abrasive blasting. Media blasting uses a chosen material, such as soda, glass or dry ice, matched to the surface, so softer materials like brick, stone and aluminium can be cleaned with less risk of damage.
What surfaces can you blast?
Steel, aluminium, concrete, brick, stone, wood and swimming pool shells, depending on the coating and the finish required.
How messy is mobile sandblasting?
We contain the work area, protect landscaping and windows, and collect the debris. Dustless blasting uses water to cut dust dramatically compared with dry blasting.
How much does sandblasting cost?
It depends on the surface, the coating being removed and access. Every job is a fixed written quote after a free assessment, so you know the price before work starts.

# Brick Cleaning & Paint Removal in Toronto
Professional brick cleaning and paint stripping without unnecessary damage to brick, mortar, windows or landscaping.
Get a Free QuoteCall (416) 663-8000
- Since 199828 years in business
- 7,500+properties cleaned
- $5Mliability insured
- WSIBcovered & ISSA-GBAC
- 4.9 / 5rated on Google
Living Water cleans brick and removes paint from interior and exterior masonry across Toronto and the GTA, choosing between chemical cleaning, controlled pressure washing and abrasive blasting after assessing the brick and the coating — so mortar, windows and plants are protected.
Reviewed by the Living Water team · November 2026 · 28 years of field experience
## At a glance
Best forInterior and exterior brick, painted masonry, mortar smears
MethodsChemical cleaning, neutralised acid washing, controlled rinsing, micro blasting
Who we serveHomeowners, builders, commercial owners
AvailabilityTest patch before full work
CoverageToronto & the GTA, Hamilton, Niagara, Barrie
QuoteFree assessment, fixed written price
Brick collects years of dirt, staining, paint, efflorescence and other build-up. Removing it is not simply a matter of more pressure — the wrong method can scar brick faces, wash out mortar, etch glass and kill landscaping. Once that damage is done, there is no going back.
That is why we assess the brick and the material to be removed before selecting a cleaning, chemical or blasting method — and always neutralise acid washes properly.

Questions
## Brick Cleaning & Paint Removal FAQ
Anything not covered here? Call (416) 663-8000 and ask.
Can paint be removed from brick without damaging it?
In most cases, yes. We use chemical strippers and controlled low-pressure rinsing, or gentle media blasting for stubborn coatings, after testing a small area.
What is a brick acid wash?
An acid wash dissolves mortar smears and mineral stains from new or old brick. It must be correctly diluted, tested and neutralised to avoid burning the brick.
Do you clean interior brick?
Yes — interior brick walls and fireplaces can be cleaned with low-moisture methods and full protection of the room.
How much does paint removal from brick cost?
It varies with the type of paint, how many layers there are, and the size and height of the wall. Every job is a fixed written quote after a free assessment, so you know the price before work starts.
Will cleaning change the colour of my brick?
Cleaning reveals the brick's original colour by removing soot, paint and staining. We test a small area first so you can see the result before we continue.
How long does brick paint removal take?
A small house wall can take a day or two. Larger buildings take longer, depending on the coating and access. We confirm the schedule in your quote.
Can you clean tall brick buildings?
Yes. We clean from boom lifts and lift baskets, mask windows and protect surrounding areas before starting.

# Historical Remediation & Heritage Facade Restoration
Respectful cleaning and restoration for historic buildings, statues and landmarks across Toronto and Ontario.
Get a Free QuoteCall (416) 663-8000
- Since 199828 years in business
- 7,500+properties cleaned
- $5Mliability insured
- WSIBcovered & ISSA-GBAC
- 4.9 / 5rated on Google
Living Water restores historic buildings, statues and landmarks in Toronto and Ontario using heritage-appropriate methods — steam cleaning, soda and micro blasting, wet and dry sandblasting, and lead paint removal — with a working knowledge of the brick, stone and metals used in Canadian construction over the past century.
Reviewed by the Living Water team · November 2026 · 28 years of field experience
## At a glance
Best forHeritage brick, stone, statues, monuments, copper and aluminium
MethodsSteam, soda and micro blasting, poultices, lead paint removal
Who we serveConservators, architects, municipalities, owners
AvailabilityTest panels for approval
CoverageToronto & the GTA, Hamilton, Niagara, Barrie
QuoteFree assessment, fixed written price
Historic buildings and landmarks are part of our shared heritage. Over time they suffer from pollution, failed coatings, efflorescence and deterioration, and restoring them is far more involved than a repaint. It requires a firm grasp of the construction and artistic materials used in Canada over the last hundred years.
Our technicians approach every heritage project with respect and care, choosing the gentlest method that will work and testing before scaling up.
## Historical remediation services
- Restoration of historical buildings
- Cleaning statues and landmarks
- Lead paint removal
- Exterior paint removal from all surfaces
- Brick cleaning and brick restoration
- Natural stone restoration and cleaning
- Efflorescence removal
- Steam cleaning
- Wet and dry sandblasting
- Aluminium and copper restoration
## Notable project: the U.S. Consulate in Toronto
One of our notable heritage projects was the U.S. diplomatic building in Toronto. Its exterior combined brick, limestone, concrete, precast, granite, aluminium and glass — each needing its own cleaning approach while protecting the building's historical integrity.

Questions
## Historical Remediation FAQ
Anything not covered here? Call (416) 663-8000 and ask.
Which cleaning methods are safe for heritage masonry?
Usually the gentlest effective method: low-pressure steam, poultices, soda or micro blasting at low pressure, and carefully tested chemical cleaners. High-pressure water and coarse sand are avoided on soft historic brick and stone.
Can you remove lead paint?
Yes. We remove lead-based paint from historic surfaces with containment and safe handling and disposal of waste.
Do you work with heritage consultants?
Yes. We regularly work alongside architects, heritage conservators and general contractors and can complete test panels for approval.
How do you protect heritage masonry during cleaning?
We test methods on a small hidden area, use the gentlest method that works, contain overspray and runoff, and mask windows, trim and landscaping.
Do you restore churches, monuments and statues?
Yes. We have cleaned heritage stone walls, limestone entrances and balconies and ornamental details across Toronto and Ontario.
How much does heritage building restoration cost?
Heritage work is priced from the surface, the extent of soiling or coating and access needs. Every job is a fixed written quote after a free assessment, so you know the price before work starts.

# Fire, Water & Wind Damage Restoration
24/7 emergency response to secure, clean and restore your home or business after fire, flood, storm or mould.
Get a Free QuoteCall (416) 663-8000
- Since 199828 years in business
- 7,500+properties cleaned
- $5Mliability insured
- WSIBcovered & ISSA-GBAC
- 4.9 / 5rated on Google
Living Water provides 24/7 disaster restoration across Toronto and the GTA — fire and smoke damage cleaning, water extraction and drying, wind and storm damage securing and repair, and mould remediation — restoring homes and businesses to their pre-loss condition. Emergency line: (647) 833-4343.
Reviewed by the Living Water team · November 2026 · 28 years of field experience
## At a glance
Best forFire, smoke, water, wind and mould damage
MethodsSecuring, extraction, drying, soot remediation, antimicrobial treatment, rebuild
Who we serveHomeowners, businesses, property managers

- 
- 
- 
When disaster strikes, every hour counts. Our team moves quickly to assess the damage, secure the property and start recovery — from a small kitchen fire to major storm damage.
## Fire damage restoration
- Inspection and evaluation — a full walkthrough to assess structure, electrical and smoke- or soot-affected zones.
- Securing the property — boarding windows and entryways to stop weather exposure and unauthorized access.
- Smoke and soot remediation — removing particles that degrade air quality and keep damaging surfaces.
- Rebuilding and restoration — structural repairs, drywall and finishing once the property is safe.
## Water damage restoration
Floods, leaks, burst pipes and failed appliances escalate quickly into mould and structural damage. We find and stop the source, extract standing water with industrial pumps and vacuums, dry walls, floors and ceilings with commercial dehumidifiers, then repair drywall, flooring and structural elements.
## Wind & storm damage restoration
We inspect for torn roofing, broken windows, stripped siding and hidden structural damage; tarp roofs and board openings to stop water getting in; complete permanent repairs; and recommend upgrades that make the property more resilient to the next storm.
## Mould removal & remediation
Our technicians locate visible and hidden mould and the moisture behind it, contain the area with negative air pressure and barriers, remove affected materials, treat surfaces with EPA-approved antimicrobials, and restore the space.

## Disaster Restoration FAQ
Anything not covered here? Call (416) 663-8000 and ask.
Do you respond to emergencies at night or on weekends?
Yes. Our emergency line, (647) 833-4343, is answered 24/7 for fire, water, wind and commercial emergencies.
Do you work with insurance claims?
We document damage with photos and written scopes that you can provide to your insurer. Contact your insurance company as soon as possible after a loss.
How fast must water damage be dried?
As soon as possible. Mould can begin growing within 24–48 hours, which is why extraction and drying start immediately.
What types of damage do you handle?
Fire and smoke, water and flood, wind and storm damage, and mould, for homes and commercial properties across Toronto and the GTA.
When should I call after a flood or fire?
As soon as it is safe. Water and smoke damage spread quickly, so calling right away limits the damage. Emergency line: (647) 833-4343, 24/7.
Will you document the damage for my insurer?
Yes. We take before-and-after photos and written notes you can send to your insurance adjuster.

# Elevator Pit Cleaning for Condos & Commercial Buildings

Living Water cleans elevator pits for condominium corporations, property managers and commercial buildings across Toronto and the GTA — removing debris, standing water, oil, sludge and sewage, then pressure washing, sanitizing and deodorizing the pit. ## Why winter is elevator pit season
From December to April, GTA buildings track in snow, slush and road salt every day. Meltwater runs through door sills and into the hoistway, salt and grit settle in the pit, and freeze-thaw cycles and spring melt push groundwater through cracks and failing sumps. Left alone, that mix becomes corrosive sludge around buffers, rails and pit equipment — and a slip hazard for the mechanics who have to work there.
- Salt-laden meltwater corrodes pit steel, buffers and rail brackets
- Wet debris and garbage become a fire and odour problem
- Groundwater seepage and sump failures peak during thaws
- Frozen and burst pipes flood lower levels and pits

We schedule with your elevator company so the car is taken out of service and locked out safely before anyone enters the pit.

Overnight, early-morning and weekend scheduling keeps residents and tenants moving. Most routine pits are done in a single visit.
### Photo report for your records
Before-and-after photos of every pit for board reports, reserve-fund studies, warranty claims and insurance.

One contractor for every building in your portfolio, with seasonal or recurring programs.
### Trusted by elevator companies

## How a pit cleaning works
- Quote — send the number of elevators, pit photos if you have them, and the building address. Fixed written price.
- Schedule — we book a time with you and your elevator contractor, often after hours.
- Lock-out — the elevator contractor takes the car out of service and secures it.
- Clean — debris and water removed, oil and sludge cleaned up, pit washed, degreased and sanitized.
- Report — before-and-after photos and notes on anything we see, such as leaks, cracks or sump issues.
## Standards and warranty context in Ontario
Elevating devices in Ontario are regulated by the Technical Standards and Safety Authority (TSSA) under the CSA B44 safety code. TSSA's elevator pre-inspection checklist calls for permanent means to prevent groundwater accumulating in the pit, and for sumps in pits to be covered. For newer condominiums, Tarion's construction performance guidelines state that elevator pits should be clear of standing water or fluids and cleaned of construction debris after construction — useful to document during first-year warranty inspections.
Your elevator contractor remains responsible for the equipment itself; Living Water handles the cleaning, pumping and sanitizing so the pit stays clean, dry and safe to work in.

- Condominium towers and townhouse complexes

## What affects the price of elevator pit cleaning?
The starting prices above cover a standard pit. Every job is confirmed as a fixed written price. The main factors that can move it are:
- Number of elevators and pits per building — multi-pit and multi-building programs are priced together
- Condition — routine debris versus standing water, oil, sludge or sewage
- Waste disposal — oily or contaminated water and material must be disposed of properly
- Pit size and depth, and access for pumps and equipment
- Timing — overnight, weekend or 24/7 emergency response
- Extras — pit painting, crack repair or deodorizing

We clean elevator pits in condominium towers and commercial buildings across downtown Toronto, North York along the Yonge corridor, Etobicoke's Humber Bay Shores, Scarborough, Mississauga City Centre, Vaughan Metropolitan Centre, Markham, Richmond Hill, Oakville, Burlington and Hamilton.
Many buildings pair pit cleaning with a spring parking garage wash to remove the winter's road salt from slabs, ramps and drains in the same visit.
Water in a pit right now? See emergency elevator pit water removal or call (647) 833-4343, 24/7.

Questions
## Elevator Pit Cleaning FAQ
Anything not covered here? Call (416) 663-8000 and ask.
How much does elevator pit cleaning cost in Toronto?
Living Water's elevator pit cleaning starts at $1,500 for a single pit (up to 4 inches of water), $2,500 for a double pit, $3,500 for a triple pit and $4,500 for four pits. Every price includes full cleaning and sanitizing so the pit is ready for paint. Prices are before HST and we confirm a fixed written quote.
What is included in the elevator pit cleaning price?
Debris and water removal, sludge and salt cleaning, pressure washing and degreasing, and sanitizing, leaving the pit clean and ready for paint. The single-pit price covers up to 4 inches of standing water.
Can you paint the elevator pit after cleaning?
Our cleaning and sanitizing leaves the pit ready for paint, and elevator pit painting and crack repair are available as add-ons.
What if the pit has more than 4 inches of water?
Deeper water, oil, hydraulic fluid or sewage needs extra pumping and disposal, so we quote it separately and tell you before work starts. For active flooding call (647) 833-4343, 24/7.
How often should a condo clean its elevator pits?
At least once a year, and more often in high-traffic buildings. Many property managers book a cleaning after winter to remove salt and meltwater residue, and immediately after any flood, leak or sewage backup.
Who is responsible for cleaning the elevator pit?
The building owner or property manager usually arranges pit cleaning. The elevator contractor maintains the equipment and controls access, so the cleaning is coordinated with them.
Do you work after hours?
Yes. We regularly schedule overnight, early-morning and weekend pit cleaning so residents and tenants are not inconvenienced.
How long is the elevator out of service?
Routine pit cleaning is usually completed in a few hours per elevator. Flood, oil or sewage clean-ups take longer depending on volume and disposal.
Do you provide insurance and WSIB documents?
Yes. We send our Certificate of Insurance ($5M commercial general liability) and WSIB clearance with every quote.
Can you clean pits in multiple buildings?
Yes. We set up one-time, seasonal or recurring programs across property management portfolios in Toronto and the GTA.
What causes water in an elevator pit?
Common causes are groundwater seepage, failed sump pumps, meltwater and salt slush tracked in during winter, sprinkler discharge, burst pipes and floor-washing water entering the hoistway.
How do I choose an elevator pit cleaning company?
Look for a contractor with $5M liability insurance, WSIB clearance, experience coordinating with your elevator company, after-hours availability and a photo report. Living Water provides all of these and a fixed written price.
Do you clean elevator pits in the middle of winter?
Yes. Winter is the busiest season because of salt slush and meltwater, and we work overnight and on weekends so elevators are back in service quickly.

## What to do right now
- Stop using the elevator. TSSA warns never to use elevators in a flooded building or where water has leaked onto elevator components.
- Call your elevator contractor to take the car out of service and assess the equipment.
- Find and stop the source if it is safe to do so — a burst pipe, sprinkler, sump or roof drain.
- Call Living Water 24/7 on (647) 833-4343 for pump-out and clean-up.
- Take photos and notify your insurer if damage is significant.
## What we do
- Pump out standing water
- Remove sludge, silt and debris
- Contain and clean up oil and hydraulic fluid
- Dispose of contaminated water and waste properly
- Clean and sanitize after sewage backups
- Pressure wash and deodorize the pit
- Photo documentation for insurance and the board
- Notes on leaks, cracks or sump problems we find
## Common causes of a flooded pit
- Groundwater seepage during thaws and heavy rain
- Failed or undersized sump pumps
- Burst or frozen pipes and sprinkler discharge
- Salt slush and meltwater tracked in during winter
- Floor-washing water running into the hoistway
- Sewer backups into lower levels
## Preventing the next one
TSSA's pre-inspection checklist calls for permanent means to prevent groundwater accumulating in pits. Talk to your elevator contractor and building engineer about sump capacity, drains and sealing cracks — and book a routine pit cleaning after winter so problems are spotted early.

Questions
## Elevator Pit Water Removal FAQ
Anything not covered here? Call (416) 663-8000 and ask.
Is it safe to use an elevator with water in the pit?
No. Take it out of service and have your elevator contractor inspect it. TSSA advises never using elevators in a flooded building or where water has reached elevator components.
How fast can you respond?
Our emergency line, (647) 833-4343, is answered 24/7 for commercial and condominium clients across the GTA.
Do you handle sewage in elevator pits?
Yes. We remove sewage-contaminated water and debris, then clean, sanitize and deodorize the pit.
How much does elevator pit water removal cost?
Our elevator pit cleaning starts at $1,500 for a single pit with up to 4 inches of water, including full cleaning and sanitizing ready for paint. Deeper water, oil or sewage is quoted separately. See elevator pit cleaning prices.
Who should I call first if there is water in an elevator pit?
Take the elevator out of service and call your elevator contractor, then call Living Water at (647) 833-4343 for pump-out and clean-up, 24/7.

# Efflorescence Removal for Brick, Stone & Masonry
White, powdery mineral deposits removed safely from brick, stone, concrete and interlock.
Get a Free QuoteCall (416) 663-8000
- Since 199828 years in business
- 7,500+properties cleaned
- $5Mliability insured
- WSIBcovered & ISSA-GBAC
- 4.9 / 5rated on Google
Efflorescence is the white, powdery salt deposit left when moisture moves through masonry and evaporates. Living Water removes it from brick, natural stone, concrete and interlock across Toronto and the GTA, and is trusted as the warranty service provider for many Ontario stone manufacturers.
Reviewed by the Living Water team · November 2026 · 28 years of field experience
## At a glance
Best forBrick, stone, precast, concrete and interlock
MethodsMaterial-specific masonry cleaners, pre-wetting, controlled rinsing
Who we serveHomeowners, builders, stone manufacturers
AvailabilityWarranty service for Ontario manufacturers
CoverageToronto & the GTA, Hamilton, Niagara, Barrie
QuoteFree assessment, fixed written price
Living Water has an extensive track record fixing new and old efflorescence problems. We assess the material first and choose the right cleaning method rather than treating every surface the same — especially important for older brick, stone and heritage masonry, where aggressive cleaning causes damage.
## Efflorescence services
- Brick efflorescence removal
- Stone efflorescence removal
- Concrete and interlock mineral deposit removal
- Exterior wall and facade cleaning
- Chemical cleaning where appropriate
- Controlled pressure washing
- Final rinsing and surface clean-up
## Will efflorescence come back?
It can return if moisture keeps moving through the material. New masonry often blooms for a season while it cures. We explain the cause on your property and the right approach — including when sealing helps.

Questions
## Efflorescence Removal FAQ
Anything not covered here? Call (416) 663-8000 and ask.
What causes efflorescence?
Water dissolves salts inside brick, mortar, concrete or stone, carries them to the surface and evaporates, leaving a white crystalline deposit.
Can pressure washing alone remove efflorescence?
Light, fresh efflorescence sometimes brushes or rinses off, but established deposits usually need a suitable masonry cleaner followed by controlled rinsing.
Is efflorescence covered by my stone warranty?
Many Ontario stone and paver manufacturers use Living Water as their warranty service provider. Check with your supplier or contact us.
How do you remove efflorescence from pavers and stone?
We use cleaners matched to the surface, applied and agitated carefully and rinsed thoroughly, because pressure washing alone only drives moisture back in. We then recommend letting the surface dry before sealing.
Will efflorescence come back?
It can return while moisture is still moving through the masonry, especially on new work. Removing it and then fixing moisture sources, and sealing when the surface is dry, reduces repeat blooms.
How much does efflorescence removal cost?
It depends on the material, the area and how severe the blooming is. Every job is a fixed written quote after a free assessment, so you know the price before work starts.

Questions
## Graffiti Removal FAQ
Anything not covered here? Call (416) 663-8000 and ask.
How fast can graffiti be removed?
We typically remove graffiti within the same week, and sooner for offensive tags or commercial clients.
Will the wall show a shadow afterwards?
Fresh graffiti removed with the right chemistry usually leaves no trace. Older tags on porous brick can leave light ghosting, which we minimise with poultices or gentle blasting.
What is an anti-graffiti coating?
A clear protective coating that makes future graffiti easier to remove without damaging the surface underneath.
How much does graffiti removal cost?
It depends on the surface, the paint and the area. Every job is a fixed written quote after a free assessment, so you know the price before work starts.
Can graffiti be removed from brick without damaging it?
Yes. We choose the gentlest remover and pressure setting that works on the brick, mortar and paint, and test first.
Do you offer recurring graffiti removal for property managers?
Yes. We set up one-off or recurring response for properties that are hit repeatedly, often removing graffiti within the same week.

Questions
## Stone Restoration FAQ
Anything not covered here? Call (416) 663-8000 and ask.
Can you clean limestone and marble safely?
Yes. Soft, acid-sensitive stones like limestone and marble are cleaned with pH-appropriate products and low pressure — never harsh acids.
Should natural stone be sealed?
Often, yes — especially patios and pool coping. Sealing helps resist staining. We advise based on the stone type and use.
Do you clean monuments and statues?
Yes. Monuments, memorials and statues are cleaned with gentle, conservation-appropriate methods.
How do you clean natural stone steps and walls?
We match the cleaner and pressure to the stone, rinse thoroughly and test a small area first, removing grime, algae, mineral deposits and stains without etching or eroding the surface.
Can rust stains be removed from stone?
Usually yes. Rust is treated with a specialised remover chosen for the stone, as we have done on stone cladding and rooftop decks.
How much does stone cleaning cost?
It depends on the stone, area, height and staining. Every job is a fixed written quote after a free assessment, so you know the price before work starts.

Questions
## Metal Restoration FAQ
Anything not covered here? Call (416) 663-8000 and ask.
Can you remove rust without damaging the metal?
Yes. We select the blasting media and pressure to suit the metal so the substrate is cleaned without unnecessary profile or thinning.
Do you restore architectural copper and aluminium?
Yes — including heritage copper and aluminium elements on historic buildings.
How is rust removed from metal?
Depending on the metal and finish, we use cleaning, abrasive or media blasting to remove rust, scale and old coatings, and can leave the metal ready for primer and paint.
Can you clean and degrease heavy equipment?
Yes. We wash and degrease tracks, undercarriages and machinery on cranes and other equipment, on site.
How much does metal restoration cost?
It depends on the metal, the condition and the size. Every job is a fixed written quote after a free assessment, so you know the price before work starts.

# Driveway & Interlock Cleaning in Toronto & the GTA
Moss, oil stains, tire marks and winter salt lifted from driveways, walkways and patios — then re-sanded so weeds stay out.
Get a Free QuoteCall (416) 663-8000
- Since 199828 years in business
- 7,500+properties cleaned
- $5Mliability insured
- WSIBcovered & ISSA-GBAC
- 4.9 / 5rated on Google
Living Water cleans concrete driveways, interlock, pavers and stone walkways across Toronto and the GTA using rotary surface cleaners and hot water for an even, stripe-free finish, pre-treats oil and rust stains, flushes out weedy joints, re-sands with polymeric sand and can seal the surface once dry.
Reviewed by the Living Water team · November 2026 · 28 years of field experience
## At a glance
Best forConcrete and interlock driveways, walkways, patios, stone paths
MethodsHot-water surface cleaning, stain pre-treatment, polymeric re-sanding, sealing
Who we serveHomeowners, HOAs
AvailabilitySpring and fall most popular; booked within 2–5 days
CoverageToronto & the GTA, Hamilton, Niagara, Barrie
QuoteFree assessment, fixed written price
- 
- 
- 
- 
- 
Driveways take the worst of Ontario weather: road salt and slush all winter, oil drips, tire marks, rust from furniture and planters, and moss and weeds wherever joint sand has washed out. A professional clean restores the colour and helps the surface last longer.
## Interlock wash, sand & seal: $3.50 per sq ft
One price for the hot-water wash, polymeric sand and protective sealer. Price your own driveway, walkway or patio in seconds.Open the cost calculator See what is included
## What's included
- Concrete, asphalt-edge and exposed-aggregate driveways
- Interlock and paver driveways, walkways and patios
- Natural stone and flagstone paths
- Oil, rust and tire mark pre-treatment
- Moss, algae and weed removal from joints
- Winter salt and calcium residue removal
- Re-sanding with polymeric sand
- Optional sealing once fully dry
- Removal of old, failing sealer
- Efflorescence treatment on new pavers
## Why a surface cleaner matters
A bare pressure-washer wand leaves stripes and can erode the paver face. We use rotary surface cleaners with hot water, which clean evenly at a safe distance and lift oil far better than cold water.
## Re-sanding and sealing
Cleaning flushes out old joint sand along with the dirt. Re-sanding with polymeric sand locks pavers in place and resists weeds and ants. Sealing is optional — it enriches colour and makes stains easier to clean — and is applied only to clean, dry pavers with no efflorescence.
## Best time to book
Spring is the most popular time, right after salt season. Late summer and early fall are ideal for sealing because pavers dry quickly.

Questions
## Driveway & Interlock Cleaning FAQ
Anything not covered here? Call (416) 663-8000 and ask.
How often should a driveway be pressure washed?
Most GTA driveways benefit from a clean once a year, ideally in spring after road salt season.
Can oil stains be removed from interlock?
Fresh and moderate oil stains usually come out with degreaser and hot water. Old, deep stains can lighten significantly but may not disappear completely on porous pavers.
Will pressure washing damage my interlock?
Not with a surface cleaner at the right pressure. We then replace the joint sand that washing removes.
Should I seal my interlock driveway?
Sealing is optional. It protects colour and resists stains, but needs clean, dry pavers and periodic re-application.
How much does interlock cleaning cost?
Our full wash, polymeric sand and seal package is $3.50 per square foot plus HST. For example, a 400 sq ft double driveway is $1,400 before HST. Use the interlock cost calculator for your own measurements.
How long does it take to clean and seal an interlock driveway?
Most residential driveways are cleaned and re-sanded in a day. Sealing needs the interlock to be completely dry, so we schedule around the weather and tell you how long to keep cars off.
Why are there weeds growing in my interlock joints?
Joint sand washes out over time, letting seeds and moss take hold. Cleaning removes the old sand, and fresh polymeric sand locks the joints so weeds and ants stay out.

# House Washing: Siding, Brick, Stone & Stucco
Green algae, black mildew, spider webs and road grime removed from your home's exterior with low-pressure soft washing.
Get a Free QuoteCall (416) 663-8000
- Since 199828 years in business
- 7,500+properties cleaned
- $5Mliability insured
- WSIBcovered & ISSA-GBAC
- 4.9 / 5rated on Google
Living Water washes house exteriors across Toronto and the GTA — vinyl and aluminium siding, brick, stone, stucco, soffits, fascia and trim — using low-pressure soft washing with biodegradable cleaners that kill algae and mildew instead of blasting them, protecting siding, mortar and window seals.
Reviewed by the Living Water team · November 2026 · 28 years of field experience
## At a glance
Best forVinyl and aluminium siding, brick, stone, stucco, soffits and trim
MethodsLow-pressure soft washing with biodegradable cleaners
Who we serveHomeowners
AvailabilitySpring to fall
CoverageToronto & the GTA, Hamilton, Niagara, Barrie
QuoteFree assessment, fixed written price
Shaded walls turn green with algae, north faces collect black mildew, and every home picks up road dust and spider webs. High-pressure washing can crack siding, force water behind panels and wash out mortar — so we soft wash.
## Surfaces we wash
- Vinyl and aluminium siding
- Brick and natural stone
- Stucco and EIFS
- Soffits, fascia and trim
- Gutter exteriors (tiger-striping)
- Windows and frames
- Porches, columns and railings
- Garage doors
## How soft washing works
- Plants, fixtures and outlets are protected and pre-wet.
- A biodegradable cleaning solution is applied at low pressure.
- It dwells to kill algae, mould and mildew at the root.
- Surfaces are gently rinsed top to bottom.
Because the growth is killed rather than knocked off, results typically last much longer than a pressure-only wash.

Questions
## House Washing (Siding, Brick & Stucco) FAQ
Anything not covered here? Call (416) 663-8000 and ask.
Is soft washing safe for vinyl siding?
Yes. Soft washing uses low pressure, so it won't crack panels or force water behind them.
How long does a house wash last?
Because soft washing kills algae and mildew, homes typically stay clean considerably longer than with pressure alone; shaded or wooded lots need cleaning more often.
Do you clean brick and stucco too?
Yes — brick, stone and stucco are washed with methods suited to each material.
How much does it cost to pressure wash a house in Toronto?
It depends on the size, the siding or masonry and how dirty it is. Every job is a fixed written quote after a free assessment, so you know the price before work starts.
Is house washing safe for windows and plants?
Yes. We use low pressure and biodegradable cleaners, mask or protect sensitive areas, and rinse nearby plants before and after.
Do you wash soffits, fascia and trim?
Yes. Soffits, fascia, trim and gutters' exteriors can be included in a house wash.

# Roof Cleaning & Moss Removal
Moss, algae streaks and lichen removed from asphalt, cedar, ceramic and metal roofs — with low-pressure soft washing, never a high-pressure wand.
Get a Free QuoteCall (416) 663-8000
- Since 199828 years in business
- 7,500+properties cleaned
- $5Mliability insured
- WSIBcovered & ISSA-GBAC
- 4.9 / 5rated on Google
Living Water removes moss, algae and lichen from asphalt shingle, cedar shake, ceramic tile and metal roofs across Toronto and the GTA using low-pressure soft washing with cleaners that kill growth at the root. High-pressure washing is not used on roofs because it strips shingle granules and splits cedar.
Reviewed by the Living Water team · November 2026 · 28 years of field experience
## At a glance
Best forAsphalt shingle, cedar, ceramic tile, metal and flat roofs
MethodsSoft washing — never high pressure on shingles
Who we serveHomeowners, property managers
AvailabilitySpring and fall
CoverageToronto & the GTA, Hamilton, Niagara, Barrie
QuoteFree assessment, fixed written price
- 
- 
- 
Black streaks on shingles are algae; green cushions are moss. Both hold moisture against the roof, lift shingle edges and speed up wear — especially on north-facing and tree-shaded slopes common across the GTA.
## Roofs we clean
- Asphalt shingle roofs
- Cedar shake and shingle roofs
- Ceramic and clay tile
- Metal roofs
- Flat roofs and rooftop terraces
- Gutters and downspouts
## Why we never pressure wash shingles
- High pressure blasts off protective granules, shortening roof life.
- It can lift and break shingles and force water under them.
- Cedar shakes split and fur when hit with high pressure.
## Our soft-wash process
Treatment is applied at low pressure, dwells to kill moss and algae, and the dead growth is gently rinsed or left to weather away. Landscaping is pre-wet and protected, and gutters are cleared of debris.

- 
-

Questions
## Roof Cleaning & Moss Removal FAQ
Anything not covered here? Call (416) 663-8000 and ask.
Does moss damage a roof?
Yes. Moss holds moisture, lifts shingle edges and can let water in, shortening the life of the roof.
Is roof soft washing safe for shingles?
Yes. Low pressure and the right cleaner remove growth without stripping granules.
When is the best time to clean a roof?
Spring and fall, when moss is actively growing and temperatures are above freezing.
How much does roof cleaning cost?
It depends on the roof size, pitch and type. Every job is a fixed written quote after a free assessment, so you know the price before work starts.
How long does it take for moss to disappear after roof cleaning?
Moss is killed by the treatment and then rinses away, with most visible results appearing in the following days to weeks.
Is it safe to clean a cedar or asphalt roof?
Yes, with low-pressure soft washing. High-pressure washing strips granules and splits cedar, so we do not use it on roofs.

# Deck & Fence Cleaning
Grey, weathered wood, mildew and stains removed from decks, fences, railings and pergolas — ready for stain or sealer.
Get a Free QuoteCall (416) 663-8000
- Since 199828 years in business
- 7,500+properties cleaned
- $5Mliability insured
- WSIBcovered & ISSA-GBAC
- 4.9 / 5rated on Google
Living Water cleans wood, composite and PVC decks, fences, railings and pergolas across Toronto and the GTA using low pressure and wood-safe cleaners that remove greying, mildew and stains without raising or furring the grain, leaving the wood ready for stain or sealer.
Reviewed by the Living Water team · November 2026 · 28 years of field experience
## At a glance
Best forWood, composite and PVC decks, fences, railings and pergolas
MethodsWood-safe cleaners, low-pressure rinse along the grain
Who we serveHomeowners
AvailabilitySpring and summer, before staining
CoverageToronto & the GTA, Hamilton, Niagara, Barrie
QuoteFree assessment, fixed written price
Sun and rain turn wood grey, shade grows mildew, and composite boards collect mould and pollen in their texture. Too much pressure gouges and furs wood, so decks and fences need a gentler approach than concrete.
## What we clean
- Pressure-treated and cedar decks
- Composite and PVC decking
- Wood, vinyl and composite fences
- Railings, stairs and pergolas
- Rooftop terraces and balconies
- Patio furniture moved and replaced
## Our approach
- Apply a wood-safe cleaner to lift grey fibres, mildew and stains.
- Rinse at low pressure, following the grain.
- Let the wood dry fully before any stain or sealer.
Cleaning before staining is the most important step for a stain that soaks in evenly and lasts.

Questions
## Deck & Fence Cleaning FAQ
Anything not covered here? Call (416) 663-8000 and ask.
Should a deck be cleaned before staining?
Yes. Cleaning removes grey fibres, mildew and old residue so new stain penetrates evenly.
Can composite decks be pressure washed?
Yes, at low pressure with a suitable cleaner. Check your manufacturer's guidelines.
How long before I can stain after cleaning?
Wood usually needs 24–48 hours of dry weather; the stain manufacturer's instructions take priority.
Do you clean boat decks, pool decks and rooftop terraces?
Yes. We also do mobile power washing of boat decks, plus pool decks, balconies and rooftop terraces.
How much does deck and fence cleaning cost?
It depends on the area, the material and the condition. Every job is a fixed written quote after a free assessment, so you know the price before work starts.
Can you clean pergolas and railings?
Yes. Pergolas, railings, fences and decks are cleaned with wood-safe methods that avoid raising the grain.

# Paver, Interlock & Natural Stone Sealing
Protect colour and resist stains on interlock, natural stone patios and pool coping — sealed only after a proper clean and dry-out.
Get a Free QuoteCall (416) 663-8000
- Since 199828 years in business
- 7,500+properties cleaned
- $5Mliability insured
- WSIBcovered & ISSA-GBAC
- 4.9 / 5rated on Google
Living Water seals interlock, concrete pavers, natural stone patios and pool coping across Toronto and the GTA. Surfaces are deep cleaned, checked for efflorescence, re-sanded and fully dried before a breathable sealer is applied, which enriches colour and makes oil, food and organic stains easier to clean.
Reviewed by the Living Water team · November 2026 · 28 years of field experience
## At a glance
Best forInterlock, pavers, natural stone, pool decks and coping
MethodsDeep clean, efflorescence check, re-sand, breathable sealer
Who we serveHomeowners, builders
AvailabilityDry weather, late spring to early fall
CoverageToronto & the GTA, Hamilton, Niagara, Barrie
QuoteFree assessment, fixed written price
- 
- 
- 
- 
Sealing is the last step of a good clean, not a shortcut around one. Sealer applied over dirt, efflorescence or damp pavers traps them — leading to white haze, peeling and blotchy colour.
## Interlock wash, sand & seal: $3.50 per sq ft
One price for the hot-water wash, polymeric sand and protective sealer. Price your own driveway, walkway or patio in seconds.Open the cost calculator See what is included
## What we seal
- Interlock driveways and walkways
- Concrete paver patios
- Natural stone and flagstone
- Pool decks and coping
- Precast steps and caps
- Removal of old, failing sealer
## Our process
- Deep clean and stain pre-treatment
- Efflorescence check and treatment if present
- Re-sand joints with polymeric sand
- Dry-out — sealer goes on dry surfaces only
- Seal with a breathable sealer suited to the material and the finish you want
## Is sealing worth it?
For driveways, pool decks and light-coloured stone, sealing makes cleaning easier and keeps colour richer. For some natural stone a breathable penetrating sealer is better than a film-forming one. We'll tell you honestly whether your surface benefits.

Questions
## Paver & Stone Sealing FAQ
Anything not covered here? Call (416) 663-8000 and ask.
How long does paver sealer last?
It depends on the product, traffic and sun exposure; most sealed surfaces need re-application every few years.
Can you seal over efflorescence?
No. Efflorescence must be removed first, or the sealer traps it and turns cloudy.
Will sealing make pavers slippery?
Some glossy sealers can; matte and penetrating sealers, or added anti-slip additive, keep traction on steps and pool decks.
How much does paver sealing cost?
Our wash, sand and seal package for interlock is $3.50 per square foot plus HST. Try the cost calculator.
When is the best time to seal pavers?
When the pavers are clean, completely dry, and temperatures are mild, typically late spring through early fall in Ontario.
Does sealing change the look of pavers?
A sealer enriches colour and can add sheen depending on the product. We tell you what finish to expect before we start.

# Parking Garage Cleaning for Condos & Commercial Buildings
Winter salt, sand, oil and grime washed out of underground and above-ground garages — scheduled with your residents and tenants in mind.
Get a Free QuoteCall (416) 663-8000
- Since 199828 years in business
- 7,500+properties cleaned
- $5Mliability insured
- WSIBcovered & ISSA-GBAC
- 4.9 / 5rated on Google
Living Water power washes underground and above-ground parking garages for condominium corporations, property managers and commercial buildings across Toronto and the GTA, removing winter road salt, sand, oil and tire grime from slabs, ramps, curbs and walls, flushing drains and working level by level after hours to keep the garage usable.
Reviewed by the Living Water team · November 2026 · 28 years of field experience
## At a glance
Best forUnderground and above-ground garages, ramps, drains
MethodsHot-water washing, salt and oil removal, drain flushing
Who we serveCondo boards, property managers, commercial owners
AvailabilityOvernight and weekend, level by level
CoverageToronto & the GTA, Hamilton, Niagara, Barrie
QuoteFree assessment, fixed written price
- 
- 
- 
Road salt carried in on tires and slush sits on garage slabs all winter. Left in place, chlorides soak into concrete and attack the reinforcing steel — one of the main causes of costly garage repairs. A thorough spring wash removes salt before it does more damage.
## What's included
- Hot-water washing of slabs, ramps and drive aisles
- Salt, sand and grit removal
- Oil and tire mark treatment
- Curbs, columns and lower walls
- Trench and floor drain flushing
- Stairwells and vestibules
- Elevator lobby and pit cleaning
- Level-by-level scheduling and signage
## Built for property managers
- Certificate of Insurance ($5M CGL) and WSIB clearance with every quote
- Overnight and weekend scheduling, one level or zone at a time
- Before-and-after photos for the board and reserve-fund records
- One contractor for garages and elevator pits
## When to wash a garage
Most buildings book a full wash in spring after salt season. High-traffic garages often add a fall wash or a mid-winter flush of entrances and ramps.
