Reference
# Pressure Washing & Restoration Glossary
Plain-English definitions of the terms used in pressure washing, blasting, masonry restoration and elevator pit cleaning.
- Since 199828 years in business
- 7,500+properties cleaned
- $5Mliability insured
- WSIBcovered & ISSA-GBAC
- 4.9 / 5rated on Google
Abrasive blastingDriving a stream of abrasive media (sand, glass, garnet, soda, walnut shell and others) at a surface under pressure to strip rust, paint, scale or coatings. Learn more →
Acid washCleaning masonry with a diluted acid-based cleaner to dissolve mortar smears and mineral stains. It must be tested, correctly diluted and neutralised. Learn more →
Anti-graffiti coatingA clear protective coating that makes graffiti easier to remove. Sacrificial coatings come off with the graffiti; permanent coatings stay in place. Learn more →
Buffer (elevator)The spring or oil device at the bottom of an elevator pit that stops a car or counterweight travelling past its normal limit. Pit debris and corrosion around buffers is a common clean-up item. Learn more →
Dry ice blastingBlasting with frozen carbon dioxide pellets that turn to gas on impact, removing coatings and residue without leaving abrasive media behind. Learn more →
Dustless blastingWet abrasive blasting where water is mixed with the media to suppress airborne dust. Learn more →
EfflorescenceA white, powdery salt deposit left on brick, concrete, stone or pavers when water moves through the material and evaporates at the surface. Learn more →
Elevator pitThe space at the bottom of an elevator hoistway, below the lowest landing, housing buffers and other equipment. It collects debris, water and oil. Learn more →
Hot-water pressure washingPressure washing with heated water, often called power washing, which cuts through oil, grease and gum faster than cold water. Learn more →
Hydro jettingUsing very high-pressure water streams to scour build-up from inside pipes, condensers and lines. Learn more →
Lime runHard white calcium carbonate deposits that streak from mortar joints, harder to remove than ordinary efflorescence. Learn more →
Micro blastingPrecision blasting with very fine media at low pressure, used on detailed or delicate masonry and stubborn coatings. Learn more →
PoulticeA paste applied to stone or brick that draws stains or paint ghosting out of the pores as it dries. Learn more →
Polymeric sandJoint sand for interlock pavers mixed with binders that harden when misted with water, resisting washout and weeds. Learn more →
Pressure washingCleaning with high-pressure water to remove dirt, grime and stains from durable surfaces like concrete and interlock. Learn more →
Soda blastingBlasting with sodium bicarbonate, a soft media suited to delicate surfaces, soot and light coatings. Learn more →
Soft washingLow-pressure cleaning that uses biodegradable cleaners to kill and remove algae, mould and mildew from siding, stucco and roofs. Learn more →
SpallingFlaking or popping of the surface of brick, stone or concrete, often caused by trapped moisture freezing and thawing. Learn more →
Sump pumpA pump in a pit or basin that removes collected water. In elevator pits, sumps must be covered and working to prevent flooding. Learn more →
Surface cleanerA rotary attachment for pressure washers that cleans flat surfaces evenly without the stripes a bare wand leaves. Learn more →
WSIB clearance certificateA document from Ontario's Workplace Safety and Insurance Board confirming a contractor's account is in good standing. Learn more →

Who we are
# About Living Water Pressure Wash Services
Meticulous care for every surface — professional pressure washing and sandblasting in Toronto and the GTA since 1998.
- Since 199828 years in business
- 7,500+properties cleaned
- $5Mliability insured
- WSIBcovered & ISSA-GBAC
- 4.9 / 5rated on Google
Living Water Pressure Wash Services Ltd. is a Toronto-area pressure washing, sandblasting and surface restoration company founded in 1998. It has cleaned 7,500+ residential, commercial, industrial and heritage properties, and is $5M insured, WSIB covered and ISSA-GBAC certified.
When your property needs expert care, you want a team that shows up prepared and delivers results that last. That is what Living Water has done for more than 28 years. From residential driveways to heritage building facades, we bring the same precision and professionalism to every job.
Our clients — homeowners, business owners, property managers and heritage conservators — trust us with their most valuable assets, and we take that responsibility seriously.
See our before-and-after gallery, read customer reviews, browse the industries we serve, or get answers in our FAQ and glossary.
## What sets us apart
- Honesty in everything we say and quote
- Expert technique with top-quality equipment matched to each surface
- Environmentally responsible methods that protect the spaces around your property
- Long-term relationships — many clients have been with us for decades

Questions
## Questions before you book
Anything not covered here? Call (416) 663-8000 and ask.
How quickly can Living Water start?
Residential jobs are usually booked within 2–5 days, and same-week service is standard. Commercial and industrial clients get 24/7 emergency response on (647) 833-4343.
Are you licensed and insured?
Yes. Living Water is fully licensed in Ontario, carries $5 million in commercial general liability insurance, is WSIB covered and ISSA-GBAC certified. We send a Certificate of Insurance to your property manager, condo board or HOA on request.
Will pressure washing damage my driveway, brick or siding?
Not when it is done right. We match the pressure, nozzle, water temperature and chemistry to each surface — interlock, brick, vinyl, stucco, stone and wood all need different approaches. Where high pressure is wrong we soft wash, steam or use media blasting instead.
Do you do commercial and industrial work?
Yes — refineries, plants, silos and tanks, heritage restoration, graffiti removal, sandblasting and elevator pit cleaning. Many of our clients are property managers, general contractors and municipalities. Our crews are certified boom and scissor lift operators.
What areas do you serve?
Toronto and the entire Greater Toronto Area, including Mississauga, Brampton, Vaughan, Markham, Richmond Hill, Oakville, Burlington, Pickering, Ajax, Whitby and Oshawa, plus Hamilton, Niagara, Guelph, Cambridge, Barrie and Simcoe County.
Is the quote free?
Yes. Assessments are free and no-obligation, and you receive a fixed written quote before any work starts.

## How we approach commercial pressure washing jobs like this
Every commercial pressure washing job starts with an on-site assessment of the surface and the soiling, followed by a test patch in an inconspicuous spot so the method and pressure are proven before the full clean. Living Water provides commercial pressure washing across Toronto and the GTA for retail plazas, office buildings, parking lots and garages, schools, restaurants, warehouses and construction sites — removing gum, grease, graffiti and stains while keeping the property open and safe.
SurfacesPlazas, storefronts, sidewalks, parking lots and garages, schools, restaurants
MethodsHot-water pressure washing, degreasing, gum and graffiti removal
Typical clientsProperty managers, condo boards, businesses
AvailabilityOvernight and weekend scheduling; 24/7 emergency line
Have a similar surface? Read more about our commercial pressure washing service or request a free, fixed written quote.
## Common questions about commercial pressure washing
Can you work after hours?
Yes. We regularly schedule commercial work overnight and on weekends so tenants, shoppers and staff are not disrupted.
Do you provide a Certificate of Insurance?
Yes. We carry $5 million commercial general liability and full WSIB coverage, and send a COI and WSIB clearance with every quote.
Can you set up a maintenance schedule?
Yes. Many property managers book seasonal or monthly cleaning for entrances, garages and walkways.

# Efflorescence cleaning on a black brick wall
- Since 199828 years in business
- 7,500+properties cleaned
- $5Mliability insured
- WSIBcovered & ISSA-GBAC
- 4.9 / 5rated on Google
White efflorescence streaks cleaned from a black brick wall, restoring an even dark finish.
ServiceEfflorescence Removal
Completed2026-11
## VideoEfflorescence cleaning on a black brick wall — video (26s)Efflorescence cleaning on a black brick wall — video (30s)
## How we approach efflorescence removal jobs like this
Every efflorescence removal job starts with an on-site assessment of the surface and the soiling, followed by a test patch in an inconspicuous spot so the method and pressure are proven before the full clean. Efflorescence is the white, powdery salt deposit left when moisture moves through masonry and evaporates. Living Water removes it from brick, natural stone, concrete and interlock across Toronto and the GTA, and is trusted as the warranty service provider for many Ontario stone manufacturers.
SurfacesBrick, stone, precast, concrete and interlock
MethodsMaterial-specific masonry cleaners, pre-wetting, controlled rinsing
Typical clientsHomeowners, builders, stone manufacturers
AvailabilityWarranty service for Ontario manufacturers
Have a similar surface? Read more about our efflorescence removal service or request a free, fixed written quote.
## Common questions about efflorescence removal
What causes efflorescence?
Water dissolves salts inside brick, mortar, concrete or stone, carries them to the surface and evaporates, leaving a white crystalline deposit.
Can pressure washing alone remove efflorescence?
Light, fresh efflorescence sometimes brushes or rinses off, but established deposits usually need a suitable masonry cleaner followed by controlled rinsing.
Is efflorescence covered by my stone warranty?
Many Ontario stone and paver manufacturers use Living Water as their warranty service provider. Check with your supplier or contact us.

ServiceResidential Power Washing
Completed2026-11
## Before & after
BeforeAfter
Before & after
## On the jobFront entrance brick and flagstone porch cleaning — on the job, photo 1Front entrance brick and flagstone porch cleaning — on the job, photo 2
## How we approach residential power washing jobs like this
Every residential power washing job starts with an on-site assessment of the surface and the soiling, followed by a test patch in an inconspicuous spot so the method and pressure are proven before the full clean. Living Water cleans the outside of homes across Toronto and the GTA — driveways, interlock, patios, brick, stone, stucco, siding, roofs, decks and fences — using low-pressure soft washing with biodegradable cleaners where high pressure would damage siding, mortar or window seals.
SurfacesDriveways, interlock, patios, siding, roofs, decks, brick and stone
MethodsSoft washing, hot-water pressure washing, surface cleaners, sealing
Typical clientsHomeowners, HOAs
AvailabilityUsually booked within 2–5 days
Have a similar surface? Read more about our residential power washing service or request a free, fixed written quote.
## Common questions about residential power washing
How often should I pressure wash my driveway?
Most GTA homeowners wash driveways and interlock every one to two years, ideally in spring to remove winter salt and again if moss or oil stains appear.
Can you clean my roof without damaging shingles?
Yes. Roofs are soft washed at low pressure with cleaners that kill moss and algae, so granules and shingles are not damaged. We clean cedar, ceramic and metal roofs.
Do I need to be home during the cleaning?
Not usually. We need access to an outdoor water tap and the areas being cleaned. We send before and after photos when the job is complete.

ServiceBrick Cleaning & Paint Removal
Completed2026-11
## Before & after
BeforeAfter
Before & after
## VideoPaint stripping on a painted brick home — video (30s)
## How we approach brick cleaning & paint removal jobs like this
Every brick cleaning & paint removal job starts with an on-site assessment of the surface and the soiling, followed by a test patch in an inconspicuous spot so the method and pressure are proven before the full clean. Living Water cleans brick and removes paint from interior and exterior masonry across Toronto and the GTA, choosing between chemical cleaning, controlled pressure washing and abrasive blasting after assessing the brick and the coating — so mortar, windows and plants are protected.
SurfacesInterior and exterior brick, painted masonry, mortar smears
MethodsChemical cleaning, neutralised acid washing, controlled rinsing, micro blasting
Typical clientsHomeowners, builders, commercial owners
AvailabilityTest patch before full work
Have a similar surface? Read more about our brick cleaning & paint removal service or request a free, fixed written quote.
## Common questions about brick cleaning & paint removal
Can paint be removed from brick without damaging it?
In most cases, yes. We use chemical strippers and controlled low-pressure rinsing, or gentle media blasting for stubborn coatings, after testing a small area.
What is a brick acid wash?
An acid wash dissolves mortar smears and mineral stains from new or old brick. It must be correctly diluted, tested and neutralised to avoid burning the brick.
Do you clean interior brick?
Yes — interior brick walls and fireplaces can be cleaned with low-moisture methods and full protection of the room.

## How we approach stone restoration jobs like this
Every stone restoration job starts with an on-site assessment of the surface and the soiling, followed by a test patch in an inconspicuous spot so the method and pressure are proven before the full clean. Living Water cleans and restores natural stone — marble, granite, limestone, sandstone and precast — on homes, commercial buildings and heritage properties across Toronto and the GTA, removing stains, mineral deposits and organic growth with methods matched to the stone.
SurfacesMarble, granite, limestone, sandstone, natural stone, precast
MethodspH-appropriate cleaners, low pressure, stain removal, sealing
Typical clientsHomeowners, commercial and heritage owners
AvailabilityAssessment before cleaning

## Common questions about stone restoration
Can you clean limestone and marble safely?
Yes. Soft, acid-sensitive stones like limestone and marble are cleaned with pH-appropriate products and low pressure — never harsh acids.
Should natural stone be sealed?
Often, yes — especially patios and pool coping. Sealing helps resist staining. We advise based on the stone type and use.
Do you clean monuments and statues?
Yes. Monuments, memorials and statues are cleaned with gentle, conservation-appropriate methods.

## How we approach industrial pressure washing jobs like this

Living Water provides industrial pressure washing and hydro jetting across Ontario — cleaning silos and tanks inside and out, manufacturing and food plants, bridges and dams, condenser pipes and heavy equipment — with safety-first planning and 24/7 emergency response.

Typical clientsManufacturers, plants, municipalities
Availability24/7 emergency response

## Common questions about industrial pressure washing
What is hydro jetting?
Hydro jetting uses very high-pressure water streams to scour build-up from the inside of pipes, condensers and lines without abrasive media.
Do you offer emergency industrial cleaning?
Yes. Industrial and commercial clients can reach our 24/7 emergency line at (647) 833-4343.
Can you clean food processing plants?
Yes. We provide pressure washing, sanitation and disinfection for food plants, scheduled around production.

# Grey paint removal from a brick home
- Since 199828 years in business
- 7,500+properties cleaned
- $5Mliability insured
- WSIBcovered & ISSA-GBAC
- 4.9 / 5rated on Google
Grey paint stripped from a brick home's exterior, with windows and doors masked.
ServiceBrick Cleaning & Paint Removal
## VideoGrey paint removal from a brick home — video (14s)Grey paint removal from a brick home — video (6s)
## How we approach brick cleaning & paint removal jobs like this
Every brick cleaning & paint removal job starts with an on-site assessment of the surface and the soiling, followed by a test patch in an inconspicuous spot so the method and pressure are proven before the full clean. Living Water cleans brick and removes paint from interior and exterior masonry across Toronto and the GTA, choosing between chemical cleaning, controlled pressure washing and abrasive blasting after assessing the brick and the coating — so mortar, windows and plants are protected.
SurfacesInterior and exterior brick, painted masonry, mortar smears
MethodsChemical cleaning, neutralised acid washing, controlled rinsing, micro blasting
Typical clientsHomeowners, builders, commercial owners
AvailabilityTest patch before full work
Have a similar surface? Read more about our brick cleaning & paint removal service or request a free, fixed written quote.
## Common questions about brick cleaning & paint removal
Can paint be removed from brick without damaging it?
In most cases, yes. We use chemical strippers and controlled low-pressure rinsing, or gentle media blasting for stubborn coatings, after testing a small area.
What is a brick acid wash?
An acid wash dissolves mortar smears and mineral stains from new or old brick. It must be correctly diluted, tested and neutralised to avoid burning the brick.
Do you clean interior brick?
Yes — interior brick walls and fireplaces can be cleaned with low-moisture methods and full protection of the room.

A stained concrete retaining wall cleaned by media blasting, with the operator in full protective gear.
ServiceSandblasting & Media Blasting
## Before & after
BeforeAfter
Before & after
## VideoConcrete retaining wall blasting — video (20s)Concrete retaining wall blasting — video (17s)Concrete retaining wall blasting — video (15s)
## How we approach sandblasting & media blasting jobs like this
Every sandblasting & media blasting job starts with an on-site assessment of the surface and the soiling, followed by a test patch in an inconspicuous spot so the method and pressure are proven before the full clean. Living Water offers mobile dustless sandblasting, wet and dry abrasive blasting, micro blasting, soda blasting and dry ice blasting across Toronto and the GTA to remove rust, scale, paint and epoxy from steel, aluminium, brick, concrete and pools.
SurfacesSteel, aluminium, concrete, pools, durable masonry, coatings
MethodsDustless wet blasting, dry blasting, micro, soda and dry ice blasting
Typical clientsContractors, pool companies, restoration firms, owners
AvailabilityMobile service across the GTA
Have a similar surface? Read more about our sandblasting & media blasting service or request a free, fixed written quote.
## Common questions about sandblasting & media blasting
Is sandblasting safe for brick?
It can be, with the right media and pressure. Soft or heritage brick often needs micro blasting or soda blasting instead of sand. We assess first and test a small area.
What is dustless sandblasting?
Dustless blasting mixes water with the abrasive media so dust is captured at the surface, making it cleaner and safer for occupied or urban sites.
Do you blast swimming pools?
Yes. We blast concrete pool shells to remove failing paint so they can be repainted.

## How we approach elevator pit cleaning jobs like this
Every elevator pit cleaning job starts with an on-site assessment of the surface and the soiling, followed by a test patch in an inconspicuous spot so the method and pressure are proven before the full clean. Elevator pit cleaning with Living Water starts at $1,500 for a single pit (up to 4 inches of water), $2,500 for a double, $3,500 for a triple and $4,500 for four pits, each including full cleaning and sanitizing so the pit is ready for paint. Living Water cleans elevator pits for condominium corporations, property managers and commercial buildings across Toronto and the GTA — removing debris, standing water, oil, sludge and sewage, then pressure washing, sanitizing and deodorizing the pit. Work is coordinated with your elevator contractor, scheduled after hours, and documented with before-and-after photos. Emergency line: (647) 833-4343, 24/7.
SurfacesCondo, rental, office, retail and institutional elevator pits
MethodsDebris and water removal, oil and sludge clean-up, pressure washing, sanitizing
Typical clientsCondo boards, property managers, elevator contractors
AvailabilityAfter-hours scheduling; 24/7 emergency line
Have a similar surface? Read more about our elevator pit cleaning service or request a free, fixed written quote.
## Common questions about elevator pit cleaning
How much does elevator pit cleaning cost in Toronto?
Living Water's elevator pit cleaning starts at $1,500 for a single pit (up to 4 inches of water), $2,500 for a double pit, $3,500 for a triple pit and $4,500 for four pits. Every price includes full cleaning and sanitizing so the pit is ready for paint. Prices are before HST and we confirm a fixed written quote.
What is included in the elevator pit cleaning price?
Debris and water removal, sludge and salt cleaning, pressure washing and degreasing, and sanitizing, leaving the pit clean and ready for paint. The single-pit price covers up to 4 inches of standing water.
Can you paint the elevator pit after cleaning?
Our cleaning and sanitizing leaves the pit ready for paint, and elevator pit painting and crack repair are available as add-ons.

## How we approach stone restoration jobs like this
Every stone restoration job starts with an on-site assessment of the surface and the soiling, followed by a test patch in an inconspicuous spot so the method and pressure are proven before the full clean. Living Water cleans and restores natural stone — marble, granite, limestone, sandstone and precast — on homes, commercial buildings and heritage properties across Toronto and the GTA, removing stains, mineral deposits and organic growth with methods matched to the stone.
SurfacesMarble, granite, limestone, sandstone, natural stone, precast
MethodspH-appropriate cleaners, low pressure, stain removal, sealing
Typical clientsHomeowners, commercial and heritage owners
AvailabilityAssessment before cleaning
Have a similar surface? Read more about our stone restoration service or request a free, fixed written quote.
## Common questions about stone restoration
Can you clean limestone and marble safely?
Yes. Soft, acid-sensitive stones like limestone and marble are cleaned with pH-appropriate products and low pressure — never harsh acids.
Should natural stone be sealed?
Often, yes — especially patios and pool coping. Sealing helps resist staining. We advise based on the stone type and use.
Do you clean monuments and statues?
Yes. Monuments, memorials and statues are cleaned with gentle, conservation-appropriate methods.

## Common questions about industrial pressure washing
What is hydro jetting?
Hydro jetting uses very high-pressure water streams to scour build-up from the inside of pipes, condensers and lines without abrasive media.
Do you offer emergency industrial cleaning?
Yes. Industrial and commercial clients can reach our 24/7 emergency line at (647) 833-4343.
Can you clean food processing plants?
Yes. We provide pressure washing, sanitation and disinfection for food plants, scheduled around production.

## How we approach historical remediation jobs like this
Every historical remediation job starts with an on-site assessment of the surface and the soiling, followed by a test patch in an inconspicuous spot so the method and pressure are proven before the full clean. Living Water restores historic buildings, statues and landmarks in Toronto and Ontario using heritage-appropriate methods — steam cleaning, soda and micro blasting, wet and dry sandblasting, and lead paint removal — with a working knowledge of the brick, stone and metals used in Canadian construction over the past century.
SurfacesHeritage brick, stone, statues, monuments, copper and aluminium
MethodsSteam, soda and micro blasting, poultices, lead paint removal
Typical clientsConservators, architects, municipalities, owners
AvailabilityTest panels for approval
Have a similar surface? Read more about our historical remediation service or request a free, fixed written quote.
## Common questions about historical remediation
Which cleaning methods are safe for heritage masonry?
Usually the gentlest effective method: low-pressure steam, poultices, soda or micro blasting at low pressure, and carefully tested chemical cleaners. High-pressure water and coarse sand are avoided on soft historic brick and stone.
Can you remove lead paint?
Yes. We remove lead-based paint from historic surfaces with containment and safe handling and disposal of waste.
Do you work with heritage consultants?
Yes. We regularly work alongside architects, heritage conservators and general contractors and can complete test panels for approval.

- Since 199828 years in business

Sandblasting on a new modern home, with landscaping, pool and windows fully protected.
ServiceSandblasting & Media Blasting
## On the jobModern home with sandblasting set-upSandblasting with landscaping protectedSandblasting a modern home wallModern home during sandblastingPool covered for blasting
## How we approach sandblasting & media blasting jobs like this
Every sandblasting & media blasting job starts with an on-site assessment of the surface and the soiling, followed by a test patch in an inconspicuous spot so the method and pressure are proven before the full clean. Living Water offers mobile dustless sandblasting, wet and dry abrasive blasting, micro blasting, soda blasting and dry ice blasting across Toronto and the GTA to remove rust, scale, paint and epoxy from steel, aluminium, brick, concrete and pools.
SurfacesSteel, aluminium, concrete, pools, durable masonry, coatings
MethodsDustless wet blasting, dry blasting, micro, soda and dry ice blasting
Typical clientsContractors, pool companies, restoration firms, owners
AvailabilityMobile service across the GTA
Have a similar surface? Read more about our sandblasting & media blasting service or request a free, fixed written quote.
## Common questions about sandblasting & media blasting
Is sandblasting safe for brick?
It can be, with the right media and pressure. Soft or heritage brick often needs micro blasting or soda blasting instead of sand. We assess first and test a small area.
What is dustless sandblasting?
Dustless blasting mixes water with the abrasive media so dust is captured at the surface, making it cleaner and safer for occupied or urban sites.
Do you blast swimming pools?
Yes. We blast concrete pool shells to remove failing paint so they can be repainted.

## How we approach brick cleaning & paint removal jobs like this
Every brick cleaning & paint removal job starts with an on-site assessment of the surface and the soiling, followed by a test patch in an inconspicuous spot so the method and pressure are proven before the full clean. Living Water cleans brick and removes paint from interior and exterior masonry across Toronto and the GTA, choosing between chemical cleaning, controlled pressure washing and abrasive blasting after assessing the brick and the coating — so mortar, windows and plants are protected.
SurfacesInterior and exterior brick, painted masonry, mortar smears
MethodsChemical cleaning, neutralised acid washing, controlled rinsing, micro blasting
Typical clientsHomeowners, builders, commercial owners
AvailabilityTest patch before full work
Have a similar surface? Read more about our brick cleaning & paint removal service or request a free, fixed written quote.
## Common questions about brick cleaning & paint removal
Can paint be removed from brick without damaging it?
In most cases, yes. We use chemical strippers and controlled low-pressure rinsing, or gentle media blasting for stubborn coatings, after testing a small area.
What is a brick acid wash?
An acid wash dissolves mortar smears and mineral stains from new or old brick. It must be correctly diluted, tested and neutralised to avoid burning the brick.
Do you clean interior brick?
Yes — interior brick walls and fireplaces can be cleaned with low-moisture methods and full protection of the room.

# Efflorescence removal on precast steps
- Since 199828 years in business
- 7,500+properties cleaned
- $5Mliability insured
- WSIBcovered & ISSA-GBAC
- 4.9 / 5rated on Google
White efflorescence removed from a run of precast concrete steps, restoring an even dark finish.
ServiceEfflorescence Removal
## Before & after
BeforeAfter
Before & after
## How we approach efflorescence removal jobs like this
Every efflorescence removal job starts with an on-site assessment of the surface and the soiling, followed by a test patch in an inconspicuous spot so the method and pressure are proven before the full clean. Efflorescence is the white, powdery salt deposit left when moisture moves through masonry and evaporates. Living Water removes it from brick, natural stone, concrete and interlock across Toronto and the GTA, and is trusted as the warranty service provider for many Ontario stone manufacturers.
SurfacesBrick, stone, precast, concrete and interlock
MethodsMaterial-specific masonry cleaners, pre-wetting, controlled rinsing
Typical clientsHomeowners, builders, stone manufacturers
AvailabilityWarranty service for Ontario manufacturers
Have a similar surface? Read more about our efflorescence removal service or request a free, fixed written quote.
## Common questions about efflorescence removal
What causes efflorescence?
Water dissolves salts inside brick, mortar, concrete or stone, carries them to the surface and evaporates, leaving a white crystalline deposit.
Can pressure washing alone remove efflorescence?
Light, fresh efflorescence sometimes brushes or rinses off, but established deposits usually need a suitable masonry cleaner followed by controlled rinsing.
Is efflorescence covered by my stone warranty?
Many Ontario stone and paver manufacturers use Living Water as their warranty service provider. Check with your supplier or contact us.

# Roof moss removal
- Since 199828 years in business
- 7,500+properties cleaned
- $5Mliability insured
- WSIBcovered & ISSA-GBAC
- 4.9 / 5rated on Google
Thick moss removed from a shingle roof with low-pressure soft washing.
ServiceRoof Cleaning & Moss Removal
## Before & after
BeforeAfter
Before & after
## On the jobCottage roof and wall soft washing
## VideoRoof moss removal — video (30s)
## How we approach roof cleaning & moss removal jobs like this
Every roof cleaning & moss removal job starts with an on-site assessment of the surface and the soiling, followed by a test patch in an inconspicuous spot so the method and pressure are proven before the full clean. Living Water removes moss, algae and lichen from asphalt shingle, cedar shake, ceramic tile and metal roofs across Toronto and the GTA using low-pressure soft washing with cleaners that kill growth at the root. High-pressure washing is not used on roofs because it strips shingle granules and splits cedar.
SurfacesAsphalt shingle, cedar, ceramic tile, metal and flat roofs
MethodsSoft washing — never high pressure on shingles
Typical clientsHomeowners, property managers
AvailabilitySpring and fall
Have a similar surface? Read more about our roof cleaning & moss removal service or request a free, fixed written quote.
## Common questions about roof cleaning & moss removal
Does moss damage a roof?
Yes. Moss holds moisture, lifts shingle edges and can let water in, shortening the life of the roof.
Is roof soft washing safe for shingles?
Yes. Low pressure and the right cleaner remove growth without stripping granules.
When is the best time to clean a roof?
Spring and fall, when moss is actively growing and temperatures are above freezing.

- Since 199828 years in business
- 7,500+properties cleaned
- $5Mliability insured
- WSIBcovered & ISSA-GBAC

A long stone cladding wall cleaned below a glass railing, with ground protection laid out.
ServiceStone Restoration
## On the jobTechnician cleaning stone claddingStone cladding after cleaningStone wall before cleaningStone wall and glass railingStone wall after cleaning
## VideoStone cladding wall cleaning — video (9s)Stone cladding wall cleaning — video (6s)
## How we approach stone restoration jobs like this
Every stone restoration job starts with an on-site assessment of the surface and the soiling, followed by a test patch in an inconspicuous spot so the method and pressure are proven before the full clean. Living Water cleans and restores natural stone — marble, granite, limestone, sandstone and precast — on homes, commercial buildings and heritage properties across Toronto and the GTA, removing stains, mineral deposits and organic growth with methods matched to the stone.
SurfacesMarble, granite, limestone, sandstone, natural stone, precast
MethodspH-appropriate cleaners, low pressure, stain removal, sealing
Typical clientsHomeowners, commercial and heritage owners
AvailabilityAssessment before cleaning
Have a similar surface? Read more about our stone restoration service or request a free, fixed written quote.
## Common questions about stone restoration
Can you clean limestone and marble safely?
Yes. Soft, acid-sensitive stones like limestone and marble are cleaned with pH-appropriate products and low pressure — never harsh acids.
Should natural stone be sealed?
Often, yes — especially patios and pool coping. Sealing helps resist staining. We advise based on the stone type and use.
Do you clean monuments and statues?
Yes. Monuments, memorials and statues are cleaned with gentle, conservation-appropriate methods.

# Efflorescence removal on a stone wall
- Since 199828 years in business
- 7,500+properties cleaned
- $5Mliability insured
- WSIBcovered & ISSA-GBAC
- 4.9 / 5rated on Google
White mineral streaks removed from a manufactured stone wall.
ServiceEfflorescence Removal
## Before & after
BeforeAfter
Before & after
## How we approach efflorescence removal jobs like this
Every efflorescence removal job starts with an on-site assessment of the surface and the soiling, followed by a test patch in an inconspicuous spot so the method and pressure are proven before the full clean. Efflorescence is the white, powdery salt deposit left when moisture moves through masonry and evaporates. Living Water removes it from brick, natural stone, concrete and interlock across Toronto and the GTA, and is trusted as the warranty service provider for many Ontario stone manufacturers.
SurfacesBrick, stone, precast, concrete and interlock
MethodsMaterial-specific masonry cleaners, pre-wetting, controlled rinsing
Typical clientsHomeowners, builders, stone manufacturers
AvailabilityWarranty service for Ontario manufacturers
Have a similar surface? Read more about our efflorescence removal service or request a free, fixed written quote.
## Common questions about efflorescence removal
What causes efflorescence?
Water dissolves salts inside brick, mortar, concrete or stone, carries them to the surface and evaporates, leaving a white crystalline deposit.
Can pressure washing alone remove efflorescence?
Light, fresh efflorescence sometimes brushes or rinses off, but established deposits usually need a suitable masonry cleaner followed by controlled rinsing.
Is efflorescence covered by my stone warranty?
Many Ontario stone and paver manufacturers use Living Water as their warranty service provider. Check with your supplier or contact us.

## How we approach industrial pressure washing jobs like this
Every industrial pressure washing job starts with an on-site assessment of the surface and the soiling, followed by a test patch in an inconspicuous spot so the method and pressure are proven before the full clean. Living Water provides industrial pressure washing and hydro jetting across Ontario — cleaning silos and tanks inside and out, manufacturing and food plants, bridges and dams, condenser pipes and heavy equipment — with safety-first planning and 24/7 emergency response.
SurfacesPlants, silos and tanks, food facilities, bridges, heavy equipment
MethodsHigh-pressure washing, hydro jetting, degreasing, sanitation
Typical clientsManufacturers, plants, municipalities
Availability24/7 emergency response
Have a similar surface? Read more about our industrial pressure washing service or request a free, fixed written quote.
## Common questions about industrial pressure washing
What is hydro jetting?
Hydro jetting uses very high-pressure water streams to scour build-up from the inside of pipes, condensers and lines without abrasive media.
Do you offer emergency industrial cleaning?
Yes. Industrial and commercial clients can reach our 24/7 emergency line at (647) 833-4343.
Can you clean food processing plants?
Yes. We provide pressure washing, sanitation and disinfection for food plants, scheduled around production.

## How we approach graffiti removal jobs like this
Every graffiti removal job starts with an on-site assessment of the surface and the soiling, followed by a test patch in an inconspicuous spot so the method and pressure are proven before the full clean. Living Water removes graffiti from brick, concrete, stone, metal and glass across Toronto and the GTA — usually within the same week — using bio-friendly chemical removers and controlled pressure washing selected for the surface, and can apply anti-graffiti coatings afterwards.
SurfacesBrick, concrete, stone, metal, glass and painted surfaces
MethodsBio-friendly removers, controlled pressure, poultices, anti-graffiti coating
Typical clientsBusinesses, municipalities, property managers
AvailabilitySame-week removal
Have a similar surface? Read more about our graffiti removal service or request a free, fixed written quote.
## Common questions about graffiti removal
How fast can graffiti be removed?
We typically remove graffiti within the same week, and sooner for offensive tags or commercial clients.
Will the wall show a shadow afterwards?
Fresh graffiti removed with the right chemistry usually leaves no trace. Older tags on porous brick can leave light ghosting, which we minimise with poultices or gentle blasting.
What is an anti-graffiti coating?
A clear protective coating that makes future graffiti easier to remove without damaging the surface underneath.

## Service area FAQ
Anything not covered here? Call (416) 663-8000 and ask.
Do you serve my city?
Living Water serves the City of Toronto (including North York, Scarborough, Etobicoke and East York), Peel and Halton (Mississauga, Brampton, Oakville, Burlington, Milton), York Region (Vaughan, Woodbridge, Maple, Kleinburg, Richmond Hill, Markham, King City, Aurora, Newmarket, Georgina), Durham Region (Pickering, Ajax, Whitby, Oshawa), Hamilton, Niagara, Guelph, Cambridge, Barrie and Simcoe County.
Do you charge extra for travel outside Toronto?
Your quote is a fixed written price that already accounts for location. Call us for projects outside the listed areas — larger commercial and heritage projects across Ontario are considered.
How quickly can you get to my property?
Residential work is usually booked within 2–5 days across the GTA. Emergency and disaster restoration is answered 24/7 on (647) 833-4343.

# Health & Safety Policy
- Since 199828 years in business
- 7,500+properties cleaned
- $5Mliability insured
- WSIBcovered & ISSA-GBAC
- 4.9 / 5rated on Google
Living Water is committed to protecting our employees, clients and the public on every job we undertake. Safety is planned into every quote, not added afterwards.
- Full WSIB coverage and $5M commercial general liability insurance
- Certificate of Insurance and WSIB clearance supplied before work starts
- Certified boom and scissor lift operators
- Site-specific hazard assessment, containment and protection of people, plants and property
- Proper handling and disposal of chemicals, oil and hazardous waste
- ISSA-GBAC certified cleaning and disinfection practices
The policy applies to all employees, subcontractors and on-site personnel across all service divisions. To request the full Health & Safety Policy document, email info@livingwater-pws.com.

# Privacy Policy
- Since 199828 years in business
- 7,500+properties cleaned
- $5Mliability insured
- WSIBcovered & ISSA-GBAC
- 4.9 / 5rated on Google
## Who we are
This website, https://livingwater-pws.com/, is operated by Living Water Pressure Wash Services Ltd.
## Information we collect
When you request a quote we collect the details you provide — name, email, phone number, location and project information — so we can respond. Our web host may log standard technical data such as IP address and browser type for security.
## Confidentiality and use
We keep your personal information confidential. We do not send unsolicited emails or sell your contact information. Information is used only to respond to you and provide our services.
## Form processing
Quote requests are delivered to our inbox by a third-party form service, which processes the data only to deliver it to us.
## Analytics and cookies
We use Google Analytics to understand how visitors use this site (for example, which pages are viewed and whether a quote form or phone link was used). Google Analytics sets first-party cookies and receives your IP address, which Google uses to estimate your general location. We do not use this data to identify you, and we do not use advertising or remarketing cookies. You can block analytics with your browser settings or the Google Analytics opt-out add-on.
## Your rights
You may ask for a copy of the personal information we hold about you, or ask us to delete it, subject to legal record-keeping obligations.
## Contact us
Questions about this policy: info@livingwater-pws.com or (416) 663-8000.
